college_info.intro: Jamia Hamdard University New Delhi popular programmes are BTech, BPharma, and MBA. For MBA students, the university organises Biz-Quiz, Management Fests, Debates, Ad-mad shows, and others. Hamdard New Delhi also arranges guest lectures & student and faculty exchange programmes for MBA students. MBA students can work as Marketing Managers, Consultants, & also Finance Managers, or can take up several other job opportunities. Jamia Hamdard New Delhi BTech students can work as Software Engineers, Data Scientists, and others. Overall, Hamdard University Delhi is one of the highest-ranked universities present in India. reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: If you want to relax and only degree, then go.

review_content.Placements: About 70% student got placement. The highest package is 30 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Companies like Wipro, HCL, and some foreign companies recruit. Students got 100% internship roles like developed trainee and so on. My college fees are so high, about 9 lakhs too.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities are enough, okay, but infrastructure needs construction, and some classes are not well organized. So Wi-Fi also does work proper. The hostel is good, but there is also a bad thing about wash room. Overall, there is no much facilities provide as other.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. in International Studies and Global Politics - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Truly satisfied with the campus life and facilities.

review_content.Placements: This is a new course in Jamia Hamdard. My batch is the second batch, so I don’t have any idea about placements, but the university also offers M.A. in this course as well as Ph.D. in this course. This course has good scope in India and especially outside.
review_content.Infrastructure: Amazing infrastructure; they provide Wi-Fi, AC classrooms, a decent library, and they have around 4–5 canteens with good quality food. They conduct sports events and tournaments every few months, so overall a good experience. I don’t have any idea about hostel, but the rest everything is nice, and they also have a hospital on campus.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: I am not saying that the college is bad, but the students are.

review_content.Placements: 5 percent of students get placed. The highest package is around 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. TCS and Wipro are regular recruiting companies. 30 percent of students get internships in various companies like Infosys and TCS. Roles offered are software developer and web developer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities are average. Only the canteen, campus, and medical facilities are good, the rest are average. The library is noisy every time I see it. Labs are not good, systems don't work often. Only cricket is good, no other sport. Everything is taken lightly, and there are fights very often.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Faculty members and placements are good every year, and the infrastructure is average.

review_content.Placements: Almost 70–80 percent of students get placed. The highest package is 15 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA. Recruiting organizations include some universities and hospitals. Roles offered are professor and physiotherapist roles in sports, neuro, musculoskeletal, and cardiovascular specializations. Many alumni start working abroad, and we have a wide range of options for how we want to work.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is above average, and we can rate it 4/10. Some cons include lift issues and Wi-Fi speed. Labs have almost all the required equipment. Hostel facilities are average. They charge a high amount, but facilities are not worth it. Mess and canteen are available, and their prices are reasonable. Medical facilities are good, as we have a hospital and a rehabilitation centre. In sports, we have football, volleyball, badminton, basketball, cricket, table tennis, carrom, and chess. We need improvement in all these areas.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA (Bachelor of Business Administration) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Not the best but not the worst either.

review_content.Placements: As much as I have heard, the placement records are not very high. Teachers help in getting you placed, but it is your job to find a good job, and very few students get placed from the college itself. 30 percent of the students get placed maybe much less as specific records aren't mentioned. The highest package is 10 LPA, the lowest is 2.8 LPA, and the average is 3 LPA-4.5 LPA. Several companies such as HCL, Tata, Coca-Cola, and others. From my course 70 percent of students got internships Roles that are offered are data analyst, customer executive, salesforce, managerial roles, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Poor infrastructure, bad class management, no placements, but good faculty.

review_content.Placements: Placements are very low. Usually, students go abroad. The highest is 5 LPA, the lowest is 2 LPA, and the average is 3 LPA, which is sometimes not sufficient. Companies like Dabur also visit. There are not many internships, but with a referral, you can get internships as an assistant pharmacist.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not good. Wi-Fi works only in specific places. Labs are okay, but water facilities and chemicals are missing, and equipment does not work. The hostel is good overall, and the food is good. Safety is a priority, and the hospital is nearby. There is a sports week, and the main focus is on sports and games too.

overview_faqs.question: How is hostel fee charged for the candidates who join in the middle of the session at Jamia Hamdard?
overview_faqs.answer: At Jamia Hamdard, the hostel fee is charged for the whole academic year. If a student is allotted the hostel in the middle of the session, the hostel charges are then calculated quarterly as mentioned below:First quarter: July 1 to September 30Second quarter: October 1 to December 31Third quarter: January 1 to March 31Fourth Quarter: April 1 to June 30

overview_faqs.question: Is hostel fee refunded in case of admission cancellation at Jamia Hamdard?
overview_faqs.answer: In case a student does not join the hostel but informs the Provost Office within a week after payment of the hostel fee about the withdrawal, the hostel charges are then refunded after deduction of INR 1000. In case the student withdraws admission within one month of joining of hostel, the fee is refunded after a deduction of 25% of the hostel fee. In any other case, no fee except security deposit is refundable. It is refunded to the hosteller after he/she has paid all dues and vacated the hostel.

content.Placements: Almost 70–80 percent of students get placed. The highest package is 15 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA. Recruiting organizations include some universities and hospitals. Roles offered are professor and physiotherapist roles in sports, neuro, musculoskeletal, and cardiovascular specializations. Many alumni start working abroad, and we have a wide range of options for how we want to work.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is above average, and we can rate it 4/10. Some cons include lift issues and Wi-Fi speed. Labs have almost all the required equipment. Hostel facilities are average. They charge a high amount, but facilities are not worth it. Mess and canteen are available, and their prices are reasonable. Medical facilities are good, as we have a hospital and a rehabilitation centre. In sports, we have football, volleyball, badminton, basketball, cricket, table tennis, carrom, and chess. We need improvement in all these areas.

individual_reviews.course: BBA (Bachelor of Business Administration) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Not the best but not the worst either.

content.Placements: As much as I have heard, the placement records are not very high. Teachers help in getting you placed, but it is your job to find a good job, and very few students get placed from the college itself. 30 percent of the students get placed maybe much less as specific records aren't mentioned. The highest package is 10 LPA, the lowest is 2.8 LPA, and the average is 3 LPA-4.5 LPA. Several companies such as HCL, Tata, Coca-Cola, and others. From my course 70 percent of students got internships Roles that are offered are data analyst, customer executive, salesforce, managerial roles, etc.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Jamia Hamdard?

reviews.review_heading: If you want to relax and only degree, then go.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are enough, okay, but infrastructure needs construction, and some classes are not well organized. So Wi-Fi also does work proper. The hostel is good, but there is also a bad thing about wash room. Overall, there is no much facilities provide as other.

reviews.review_heading: Truly satisfied with the campus life and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Amazing infrastructure; they provide Wi-Fi, AC classrooms, a decent library, and they have around 4–5 canteens with good quality food. They conduct sports events and tournaments every few months, so overall a good experience. I don’t have any idea about hostel, but the rest everything is nice, and they also have a hospital on campus.

reviews.review_heading: I am not saying that the college is bad, but the students are.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are average. Only the canteen, campus, and medical facilities are good, the rest are average. The library is noisy every time I see it. Labs are not good, systems don't work often. Only cricket is good, no other sport. Everything is taken lightly, and there are fights very often.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members and placements are good every year, and the infrastructure is average.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is above average, and we can rate it 4/10. Some cons include lift issues and Wi-Fi speed. Labs have almost all the required equipment. Hostel facilities are average. They charge a high amount, but facilities are not worth it. Mess and canteen are available, and their prices are reasonable. Medical facilities are good, as we have a hospital and a rehabilitation centre. In sports, we have football, volleyball, badminton, basketball, cricket, table tennis, carrom, and chess. We need ...

reviews.review_heading: Not the best but not the worst either.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi service is available, but it rarely works, and data services are negligible here. A lot of issues arise because of that. Classrooms are normal college classrooms with no AC and old fans. The library is functional with a huge number of books but most are outdated. The hostel facilities are great with good rooms, AC, and water supply. The curfew time is 9:30 PM, and the food is a bit hygienic, but not that bad. The sports facilities are great with a huge ground available, and other sports eq...

reviews.review_heading: Poor infrastructure, bad class management, no placements, but good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good. Wi-Fi works only in specific places. Labs are okay, but water facilities and chemicals are missing, and equipment does not work. The hostel is good overall, and the food is good. Safety is a priority, and the hospital is nearby. There is a sports week, and the main focus is on sports and games too.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Hamdard Institute of Medical  Sciences And Research, New DelhiReviewed on 16 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is a cute college with nice studies.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are not that great. Food is also okay, not very good, and not very bad either. Hostels are clean. College has an AC lecture theatre, library, and computer labs. Washrooms are nice. The college is overall not very big, but it has a cozy vibe.

reviews.review_heading: Jamia Hamdard University review.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and labs are available for students, and a maximum of 60 students can be in a classroom. The library is also available to assist students. Safe and separate hostels with good hygienic food quality are available for boys and girls. Majeedia Hospital provides medical facilities, and sports grounds are available for games.

reviews.review_heading: Review by a CSE day scholar student.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like classrooms are non-AC. Only the ground floor which are the LT classrooms are smart classes with AC and projector. Other classrooms are without AC. The hostel is good with a lot of facilities like laundry, Wi-Fi and electricity all over. The mess is also good. The food is also good there.

reviews.review_heading: Review by student living life on campus.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like classrooms are non-AC. Only the ground floor which are the LT classrooms are smart classes with AC and projector. Other classes also have projectors but without AC. The hostel is good with a lot of facilities like laundry, Wi-Fi and electricity all over. The mess is also good. The food is also good there.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the evergreen Jamia Hamdard University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the course is well-maintained. It has Wi-Fi, computer labs for doing editing on photoshops, Premiere Pro, Adobe software, and studios for news and radio. It provides a lot of hands-on workshops. The interior of the college where students sit is well-organised and has 99 names of Allah, where everyone feels peace alone at their free time.

reviews.review_heading: The college has supportive faculty, a room with solid placement, and is industry-ready.
reviews.review_text: Jamia Hamdard offers well-equipped laps, Wi-Fi, modern classrooms, a rich library diverse sports facilities, and so on. The campus has a hygienic mess and canteen, reliable medical services, and a sports complex for indoor and outdoor games ensuring holistic student development.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is so clean and green. It was not good in past 2010 but now it is so good.
reviews.review_text: Everything is provided on our campus like Wi-Fi and AC. Classrooms have desks and furniture. Especially every building has its own library. There are certain canteens also with good quality food. Boys and girls have separate hostels and hygiene is also good in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Overall the campus is beautiful teachers are helpful and cooperative, and the placements are okay.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi does not work properly and the college campus has jammers so cell internet doesn't work. Classrooms are getting better in facilities. There are overpriced snacks and food like coffee around 150ml is for Rs. 40 which is very helpful in summer. The campus events can be good if the management is done properly.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the campus, really good teaching staff and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The buildings are old. Well-equipped Labs and Classroom. The central library is the famous building of our college. The campus is very large and vast.  It has a hostel facility for girls. There are so many Pgs nearby. The food is very tasty. More than 6 canteens are there. A very sports complex is there with a Gym, basketball court volleyball, football, badminton, and tennis court.

BITS Pilani Jhunjhunu comprises of 13 departments including Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Pharmacy, Management, Science, etc. The departments of the institute offers a wide range of UG, PG, diploma, certificate and PhD programmes across various streams. placements.overview:

reviews_list.batch_info: Integrated M.Sc. (Hons.) in Mathematics - Batch of 2030
reviews_list.review_title: It provides freedom to explore personal interests.

review_content.Placements: Placements of BITS Hyderabad are very good at around 91% and throughout the years, it has also seen a constant rise. Overall Average CTC for BITS Hyderabad is around 20LPA. Top recruiters include Atlassian, Dell, Google, Microsoft, Deloitte, Oracle, Adobe, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostels at BITS are clean and spacious. Each hostel also includes common rooms with indoor games like air hockey and table tennis, and outside courts for badminton and volleyball. Mess food is a well-balanced meal and made in hygienic places. The medical centre is open 24/7, and also ambulances come to the hostel gate in case of emergency. Courts and other playing facilities are well-maintained for every sport.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Worth the high fees due to ROI, but after entering, hard work is expected to excel.

review_content.Placements: The percentage placement is high, due to the brand name as well as quality of students. More than 80% of batch was planned with highly reputed companies with high packages in fields of tech, finance, and core came to hire, eg, Google, BlackRock, Nvidia, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Entire campus is Wi-Fi covered, and classrooms are well maintained with blocks assigned to departments like mechanical, CS, and electrical. Library is also pretty big, with a capacity of 600+, and it has a great interior, and provides a peaceful vibe for studying. Quality of hostel and mess is also good, food taste is decent with a different menu.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: The college has good infrastructure, environment, facilities, and placement prospects.

review_content.Placements: The better part is that over 80% of students find placements. The lowest salary would be around 8 LPA, while the highest could exceed 40 LPA, with the average being 12 LPA. Top recruiters include Mercedes, L&T, and BHEL from the mechanical stream, and students can also choose to pursue non-teaching roles, which many do. As mentioned above, the top roles include analyst, management, and R&D.
review_content.Infrastructure: Ethernet connectivity is available in hostel rooms and the library (1 Gbps speed), with Wi-Fi throughout the hostel and academic block, and in the library (100 Mbps). The food can be considered fair, with the menu undergoing slight changes every two months. For the mechanical department, we have dedicated labs, workshops, and sandbox areas.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Review of BITS Pilani K K Birla, Goa Campus.

review_content.Placements: More than 80% of students got placed. A lot of companies recruit students, including Microsoft, Google, Rubric, Dell, Deloitte, Oracle, Adobe, Nestle, etc. Top roles include software developer, analyst, app developer, product management, etc. The median package is 17 LPA. Core branches like electrical have an average salary of 18 LPA - 20 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facility is very good. The academic block is beautiful, consisting of 4 lecture theatres and a lot of classrooms. Some labs are also present. A big canteen includes a kitchen and a Nescafe shop. There is also a big auditorium in the basement. There is a football and cricket ground with floodlights. Other sports facilities are also available. Hostels of the new block are very good with fully furnished rooms and 2 common washrooms on each floor. The campus is beautiful and green.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: The overall experience with college is really good and I will definitely recommend it to others.

review_content.Placements: I am still pursuing my degree which is WILP B.Sc. in computer and designing programs from BITS, and it has really a great experience till now. As for the package and everything the students get a very good and satisfactory package. Top recruitment companies in BUTS are Accenture, Cognizant, EY, HSBC, Yes Bank, and KPMG. The highest package offered to CS IT students at BITS is 60 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: BITS is a fully residential campus with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including well-equipped laboratories, modern classrooms, a gymnasium, a swimming pool, various sports grounds, and campus-wide internet connectivity. The labs and classrooms are good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Ups and downs of BITS through some unknown insights.

review_content.Placements: In my course, according to the current data, almost 98.57% of students got placed even with the current recession era. The highest salary package offered is 84 LPA. The average salary package offered is 18.34 LPA, and the lowest salary package is not mentioned to us. Top recruiting companies like Google, Amazon, and Nvidia visit the college for placements. The internship is compulsory in our college, and our college itself provides us with it through a scheme called practice school.
review_content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi facility in our hostel is not good. The land cables work better than the Wi-Fi. Classrooms are neat and tidy. Hostels are clean, but there is a dumping ground near, which sometimes ends with a bad odour. The mess food is better than most of the colleges, and the canteen is affordable. Sports facilities are quite good and almost every sports facility is available. We all get medical insurance.

BITS Pilani faculty is highly qualified and experienced faculty from across the world, and hiring them is costly. The institute has a strong reputation for its graduates who are highly sought after by top companies in India and abroad.

hostel_campus.college_name: BITS Pilani Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: The Institute is fully residential and hostel accommodation is provided to all students. There are eleven hostels for boys and one hostel complex for girls. The hostel rooms are fully furnished. Common room facilities with Cable TV and telephone are available in each hostel. Internet connectivity has been provided in all hostel rooms. Solar water heating systems are provided in all the hostels. There is a common kitchen cum mess unit for every set of two boys hostels. Girls hostel, however, has a separate mess of its own, situated within the boundary of the hostel. It is mandatory for the students staying in the hostel to have their food in the hostel messes. The messes attached to hostels are fully managed by the students.

library.description: Library has room for up to 8,000 students, offers 738 open access study places and 246 open-access IT work stations.  As well as the books and periodicals you expect, it is home to computing facilities for students.The library is searchable via the library catalogue.  But it is not only our library you will have access to – as a BITS Pilani student you can use a network of other libraries via our membership.

sports.description: Available Facilities: Swimming Pool, Football, Hockey, Cricket, Basketball, Volleyball, Tennis, Badminton, Table Tennis, Athletics, Water Polo, Weight Lifting

reviews.batch: Batch of 2030Offered by BITS Pilani, Hyderabad CampusReviewed on 28 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It provides freedom to explore personal interests.
reviews.review_text: Hostels at BITS are clean and spacious. Each hostel also includes common rooms with indoor games like air hockey and table tennis, and outside courts for badminton and volleyball. Mess food is a well-balanced meal and made in hygienic places. The medical centre is open 24/7, and also ambulances come to the hostel gate in case of emergency. Courts and other playing facilities are well-maintained for every sport.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by BITS Pilani, Hyderabad CampusReviewed on 4 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Worth the high fees due to ROI, but after entering, hard work is expected to excel.
reviews.review_text: Entire campus is Wi-Fi covered, and classrooms are well maintained with blocks assigned to departments like mechanical, CS, and electrical. Library is also pretty big, with a capacity of 600+, and it has a great interior, and provides a peaceful vibe for studying. Quality of hostel and mess is also good, food taste is decent with a different menu.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by BITS Pilani, Hyderabad CampusReviewed on 16 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure, environment, facilities, and placement prospects.
reviews.review_text: Ethernet connectivity is available in hostel rooms and the library (1 Gbps speed), with Wi-Fi throughout the hostel and academic block, and in the library (100 Mbps). The food can be considered fair, with the menu undergoing slight changes every two months. For the mechanical department, we have dedicated labs, workshops, and sandbox areas.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by BITS Pilani K K Birla, Goa CampusReviewed on 12 Feb 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Review of BITS Pilani K K Birla, Goa Campus.
reviews.review_text: The facility is very good. The academic block is beautiful, consisting of 4 lecture theatres and a lot of classrooms. Some labs are also present. A big canteen includes a kitchen and a Nescafe shop. There is also a big auditorium in the basement. There is a football and cricket ground with floodlights. Other sports facilities are also available. Hostels of the new block are very good with fully furnished rooms and 2 common washrooms on each floor. The campus is beautiful and green.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by BITS Pilani, Hyderabad CampusReviewed on 11 Feb 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The overall experience with college is really good and I will definitely recommend it to others.
reviews.review_text: BITS is a fully residential campus with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including well-equipped laboratories, modern classrooms, a gymnasium, a swimming pool, various sports grounds, and campus-wide internet connectivity. The labs and classrooms are good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by BITS Pilani, Hyderabad CampusReviewed on 24 Jan 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Ups and downs of BITS through some unknown insights.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi facility in our hostel is not good. The land cables work better than the Wi-Fi. Classrooms are neat and tidy. Hostels are clean, but there is a dumping ground near, which sometimes ends with a bad odour. The mess food is better than most of the colleges, and the canteen is affordable. Sports facilities are quite good and almost every sports facility is available. We all get medical insurance.

reviews.review_heading: Worth it to take admission here.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of this college are awesome. Wi-Fi is available throughout the college campus, classrooms, library, and labs. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is top-notch. Medical facilities are also available 24/7, and sports and games are also good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by BITS Pilani K K Birla, Goa CampusReviewed on 2 Nov 2024)
reviews.review_heading: One of the best engineering colleges in India.
reviews.review_text: The course and hostel are absolutely amazing, other than one big downside, which is the food. The food is horrendous, and you eat it just for the sake of staying alive. The paid canteens are good, but the mess is bad. All classrooms are air-conditioned, with Wi-Fi throughout the campus. The library has a wide range of books to cover every genre. Sports and games are widely encouraged, and there are multiple football grounds, as well as a gym and badminton/tennis courts.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by BITS Pilani K K Birla, Goa CampusReviewed on 28 Oct 2024)
reviews.review_heading: BITS Pilani - It's Magic.
reviews.review_text: We have great infrastructure at BITS Goa. The Goa campus is really beautiful, full of greenery, and Goa itself is also a very beautiful state. The campus is very clean, with almost no littering on the roads. Spread over 180 acres, it’s smaller than Pilani and Hyderabad, but you still have to walk a lot. college_info.intro:
Punjab University offers various Certificate, Diploma, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and PhD programmes in multiple streams such as Business and Management Studies, Accounting and Commerce, Arts (Fine/ Visual/ Performing), Design, Engineering, Humanities and Social Sciences, Law, Medicine, and Health Sciences, and Science, and so on. PUCHD eligibility varies from course to course. Candidates must fulfil the eligibility criteria to be able to apply for the course. Punjab University's flagship courses are MBA, BTech, BSc, and BA.
Punjab University offers these courses in full-time mode for the duration of 2 to 5 years. PUCHD fee structure includes tuition fees ranging from INR 480 to INR 6.19 Lakh. Punjab admissions to any of the course is based on merit and entrance exam. Therefore, candidates must secure the suggested minimum aggregate in Class 12 and graduation. Apart from this, candidates must secure valid score in accepted entrance exams such as JEE Main, CAT, MAT, XAT, PU MET, JAC Chandigarh etc. Considering the ROI, Panjab University UIET recorded the placement stats with the highest package of INR 42 LPA. For more details, candidates must visit the official website.

admission_overview.description: Panjab University Chandigarh admission process is based on the entrance examination and merit. Panjab University Chandigarh is currently open for admission. The university offers programmes including MA, BA, BBA, MBA, MLib and many more. Panjab University conducts multiple entrance exams, such as PUMET, PU-CET (UG), PU-CET (PG), PU PGLAW, PUTHAT, PULEET, MBAUSOL, PU UGLAW, PU MPhil, and PhD Entrance Test for admission to its various courses. For a few courses, such as MA, BA, MLib, etc., admissions are completely based on merit in the last qualifying examination. Students must go through the Panjab University CHD-conducted/ national-level entrances and then appear for the university-level selection rounds for final admission at Panjab University.

paragraphs: Panjab University admissionhas multiple steps and can be completed online. Admission to UG and PG courses is based on merit and entrance exams. Find below the admission process for Panjab University:
Application Process

Students interested in getting in Panjab University need to submit online application for all UG and PG courses atugadmissions.puchd.ac.inoronlineadmissions.puchd.ac.inas per their preferred course. Panjab University application process is conducted in online mode. The application process for Punjab University admission is generally released in April, every year. Check here thePanjab University admit cardfor popular entrance examination.
Selection Criteria & Release of Merit Lists

After filling out the Punjab University admission form, you need to go through the selection rounds of the desired course. After the rounds are over, course-wise merit lists are posted on the official website.
Final Admission Confirmation
Post the selection rounds, candidates who are shortlisted and have their names on the merit lists can submit the fee and confirm their admission to the relevant course at Panjab University.

reviews.review_text: Classrooms are just natural saunas. Just walk 5 minutes you’ll complete the campus tour. The labs and library are decent. Sports facilities are barely accessible. reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by University Institute of Engineering and Technology, Panjab UniversityReviewed on 17 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: The college is top-notch choice if you want a balance of everything in life.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well maintained, with a few having AC. Hostels are top-notch with all facilities and no restrictions. Hostel staff is also very good. The hostels are well maintained. There are too many hostels, and students have the choice to choose according to their needs.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Post Graduate Government CollegeReviewed on 16 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: A practical and student-friendly college.
reviews.review_text: The college has very good infrastructure and is one of the bigger colleges under Panjab University. The classrooms are big and have blackboards as well as smartboards for good audio-visual aids. There is also a library that has a wide range of books available. Hostel facilities are available for both boys and girls with decent facilities. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Post Graduate Government CollegeReviewed on 5 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: The college and students are too good. The environment of the college is positive.
reviews.review_text: There are 3 computer labs in the college. It provides a good network connection. The mess in the hostel is okay. The canteen provides food at an affordable price. It has Nescafé, Verka, and juice corners in the college for students and teachers. There are sports rooms with different games.

admission_process.title: JSS College of Pharmacy Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: JSS College of Pharmacy Ooty admission 2025 is entrance-based for most of the courses. The college in affiliation toJSS Academy of Higher Education and Researchoffers 17 courses through the Faculty of Pharmacy at UG, PG, PhD, and diploma levels. BPharm, MPharma and DPharm are the popular courses offered by the college. JSS College of Pharmacy offers SSP Post-Matric Scholarship,Karnataka Labour Welfare Board Scholarship, etc. to meritorious students.

Courses in design are available at the JSS College of Pharmacy in a variety of specialisations, including Remedial Biology, Remedial Mathematics and Remedial Biology-Practical. Aspiring applicants must complete the selection criteria and fulfil the eligibility requirements for each course to be admitted to one of Moople's courses. The table below provides details regarding the eligibility and selection criteria for a range of popular undergraduate courses:

JSS College of Pharmacy course admissions 2025are merit-based. Candidates can apply for their preferred course after checking the eligibility criteria. Below are the steps to get a seat in JSS College of Pharmacy:
JSS College of Pharmacy ApplicationProcess 2025

The mode of application is online. Candidates can register online or download the application form for offline submission. Aspirants will need to fill out the details and upload their marksheet to complete the application process.

Candidates are selected based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. Selected candidates are further called for a personal interview round. The institute may conduct an entrance exam to shortlist aspirants.
Admission confirmation:

Selected candidates are then required to secure their admission within the prescribed date and time at the institute campus by depositing relevant fee via debit card, credit card, internet banking and UPI.

paragraphs: NIPER Hyderabad Admissionwill be based on the combined merit obtained by a candidate in the entrance examination and interview. Interview of the eligible candidates for the Ph.D. Programme will be conducted based on the merit in the entrance examination. Find below the step-wise explanation of the admission process at NIPER Hyderabad:
lists: Application: Go to the official NIPER Hyderabad website and register for the entrance examination, NIPER JEE- Master's and NIPER JEE - PhD for PG and PhD programmes, respectively.

Entrance examination: Appear for the entrance examination that you have registered for. The exam will be a CBT and will be held simultaneously at different centres pan India. Appear for the exam at the centre mentioned by the admit card.
Interview: PhD candidates must also appear for the interview round after entrance examination.

Online Counselling:Selected Candidates will be then called for counselling. PhD candidates will be sleected on the basis of combined scores in Entrance examination and Interview. PG candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of entrance examination scores only.

Admission confirmation: The allotted seat for the successful candidates shall be confirmed only after the payment of the requisite fees immediately after the counselling if admission is offered to the candidate. Candidates will be required to upload the requisite original documents. At the time of reporting at the institute, the candidate will have to deposit these documents.

reviews.review_heading: A trustworthy college with good rankings.

reviews.review_heading: This college is an absolute fit for students seeking admission in pharmaceutical.

review_summary.college_name: ICT Mumbai Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: ICT: The best college for chemical engineering.

content.Placements: ICT Mumbai has a record of offering 100% placement to students in the bachelor of chemical engineering courses. The highest package offered this year (2024) was 20 LPA by Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL). The average package is in the range of 13-14 LPA for the B. Chem. engineering course. Top recruiting companies are BPCL, HPCL, Reliance Industries, Sun Pharma, Pidilite Industries, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are excellent as far as academics are concerned. There are well-equipped labs for research. College Wi-Fi is made available after registration. Hostel facilities are available if the student lives more than 70km away from campus. The mess is available along with the Hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Oils, Oleochemicals and Surfactants Technology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Not just any other college, institute of culture, or institute of tradition.

content.Placements: I believe over the years, placements have increased. The majority of students prefer to go outside India to pursue a master's Ph.D. Big companies like Godrej, Nerolac Paints, Asian Paints, and PPG come for campus placements. Over the years, the institute has been working towards achieving better placements.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped and have all the amenities. The most important is the lab. There is no lab facility like what ICT have. The hostel has all amenities including washing machines. The cleaning staff is also good and very supportive. It is one of the most comfortable stays.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Fibres and Textile Processing Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A Very Underrated Government College.

content.Placements: Placements are average, not up to expectations. The highest package for Textile 2024 was 16 LPA, and 2-3 people got it. Top recruiters are Trident, Arvind, and more. Almost all 3rd and 4th year students get internships. This is the textile processing branch; they teach textile chemistry here.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are good for the textile department. Labs for the textile department are good, not very good. Hostel facilities are good, mess food is okay, also cheap. Fees are only 36,000 for the year. There's a snooker table at the hostel and a turf to play cricket, and also basketball and volleyball courts.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Fibres and Textile Processing Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review on Institute of Chemical Technology.

content.Placements: 50% students get placed, and the rest go for higher studies. The highest is 16 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Recruiting companies are Trident, Bitra, Archroma, Aditya Birla, Reliance, BSaf, Siyaram, Vardhman, etc. Roles offered can range from marketing to shop floor work.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms have air-conditioning and projectors. The library is well-equipped with books and journals. The food quality at the hostel is bad. Sports and games facilities are available. Hostel rooms are affordable, although they are quite small in size. The canteen food menu is limited, and the food is oily.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good for aspirants who are willing to do research or opt for higher studies.

content.Placements: The eligibility for placement is that you have to clear all subjects, and in the 7th semester, companies hire students based on performance in mock group discussions and interviews. The average placement offer is between 3-5 LPA. Companies like Glatt and Sun Pharma hire B Pharma students based on their requirements.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors, and Wi-Fi is accessible once you get admission to ICT. The labs are top-notch; you will get different sections of labs in the pharma department, such as general labs, pharmacology labs, and pharmacetics labs. In the ICT campus, there are four hostels. UG students are admitted in hostel number 5, which is the best hostel among others based on facilities.

The admission process for ICT Mumbai is a multi-step process inclusive of application, appearance in the selection rounds and counselling process. A step-by-stepICT Mumbai admission processis as follows:
Step 1: ICT Mumbai Application Process

The admission process begins with filling out an online application form on the official website of the Institute of Chemical Technology (after clearing the entrance exam for respective courses). Candidates can apply for the course of their choice along with paying an application fee.
Step 2: ICT Mumbai Other Selection Rounds

Admission to ICT Mumbai courses is entrance-based. For entrance-based admission, candidates are required to qualify for entrance exams for the respective courses. Further, there are other selection rounds such as GDPI conducted as part of the selection process. For the MSc course, the ICT also conduct admission tests.
Step 3: ICT Mumbai Counselling Process/ Merit Release
Based on the scores in the respective entrance exams, past academic records and performance of candidates in other selection rounds, the university releases a merit list.
Step 4: Provisional Admission Notice

After the release of the merit list, a provisional admission notice will be sent to the selected candidates. Later on, candidates can proceed with the other admission formalities such as fee payment and document verification (if required). For more details about the final admission process, candidates may visit the official website of ICT Mumbai.

faqs.question: Is MPharma offered by ICT Mumbai?
faqs.answer: Yes, MPharma is available at ICT Mumbai. In the field of Pharmacy, ICT Mumbai offers a two-year MPharma course across three specialisations, at the PG level. The first year of the course is dedicated to coursework and the second year is for the research project. Accredited by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), admission to MPharma at the Institute of Chemical Technology, Mumbai is based on a valid score in the GPAT exam followed by an institute-level test and interview.

nirf.description:
As per the overall score, ICT Mumbai has been placed at a good position by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category, reflecting its exceptional performance in areas like Teaching, Research, Graduation Outcomes, and creating an inclusive, quality learning environment. When compared to the ranking from the previous years, it has been seen that in the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown a decreasing trend. In 2025, ICT Mumbai fell 8 ranks to #64 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
One can observe that within the category of 'University', the institute's ranking has fallen when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, ICT Mumbai fell 5 ranks to #40 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
The institute has displayed a fluctuating trend in the 'Engineering' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, ICT Mumbai's rank is #41, the same as last year's rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
The institute's ranks in the 'Pharmacy' category; have shown a fluctuation when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, ICT Mumbai fell 1 rank to #6 rank in the 'Pharmacy' category by the NIRF ranking.

library.description: Institute of Chemical Technology's library has a collection of 77102 books, bound volumes and reports, 4848 theses, 125 journals (printed) and 5 databases. It performs a dual role of an academic library as well as a research library. It is housed in a separate ground plus two-storied building and follows a completely open-access concept. The library is fully computerized using the library management software called Libsys. It can be termed as a hybrid library with the best collection of printed and digital documents. The library is also a member of E-ShodhSindhu Consortium. The library has a facility of circulation service, reference and referral service, current awareness service, bibliographic service, photocopying service, user orientation programs, e-resources training programs and book bank service.

reviews.review_heading: ICT: The best college for chemical engineering.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are excellent as far as academics are concerned. There are well-equipped labs for research. College Wi-Fi is made available after registration. Hostel facilities are available if the student lives more than 70km away from campus. The mess is available along with the Hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Not just any other college, institute of culture, or institute of tradition.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-equipped and have all the amenities. The most important is the lab. There is no lab facility like what ICT have. The hostel has all amenities including washing machines. The cleaning staff is also good and very supportive. It is one of the most comfortable stays.

reviews.review_heading: A Very Underrated Government College.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are good for the textile department. Labs for the textile department are good, not very good. Hostel facilities are good, mess food is okay, also cheap. Fees are only 36,000 for the year. There's a snooker table at the hostel and a turf to play cricket, and also basketball and volleyball courts.

reviews.review_heading: Review on Institute of Chemical Technology.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have air-conditioning and projectors. The library is well-equipped with books and journals. The food quality at the hostel is bad. Sports and games facilities are available. Hostel rooms are affordable, although they are quite small in size. The canteen food menu is limited, and the food is oily.

reviews.review_heading: Good for aspirants who are willing to do research or opt for higher studies.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors, and Wi-Fi is accessible once you get admission to ICT. The labs are top-notch; you will get different sections of labs in the pharma department, such as general labs, pharmacology labs, and pharmacetics labs. In the ICT campus, there are four hostels. UG students are admitted in hostel number 5, which is the best hostel among others based on facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Institute of Chemical Technology, Marathwada CampusReviewed on 25 Sep 2024)
reviews.review_heading: The college for fortunate students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very poor because the actual campus of ICT Jalna college is under construction, so, at the moment, the college infrastructure is not that good and is rental. Although it's good if you're more focused on education instead of infrastructure. Regarding labs and classrooms, they are very good; all labs are equipped, and all the instruments are new and good. Classrooms are also good, with ACs and digital classroom logistics.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for chemical engineering fields.
reviews.review_text: Quality of the food in the mess is quite good as compared to other college's mess, and the canteen is even better and also not too expensive. For sports, basketball, volleyball, Badminton court is there and also turf is there for football. As such medical facilities are not there.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for Masters in pharma.
reviews.review_text: The college  infrastructure and campus is really cool. We have many labs in the college along with a new incubation centre which was developed this year. 24 hours Wi-Fi service is available in the college. They also provide a digital library which can be accessed from any location. College hostel has limited seats providing triple sharing rooms having separate beds, tables, fans, and water filter facilities. Mess food was decent in quality but the canteen’s food is really good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by IndianOil Odisha Campus, Bhubaneswar, Institute of Chemical Technology, MumbaiReviewed on 16 Apr 2024)
reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are of top level with 24 hrs electricity and Wi-Fi availability. The classrooms, library, and the labs are fully air conditioned Hostels provides room with 4 students sharing each room having attach washrooms. Washing machines are provided for washing clothes. Food quality is also good in the mess. Our college is tied up with KIIMS for medical facilities. There are issues with outdoor games like cricket and basketball as we are currently in a temporary campus and do not have access to...

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and great college.
reviews.review_text: Life on campus is lively, with a good social life and many clubs to join. The infrastructure was really good, with a well-stocked library and big classrooms. We have an annual fest called Vortex. Many enjoyable moments and events are held here. The hostel needs to be good; the accommodation is average and the food is also not good. Management needs to take care of these things.

reviews.review_heading: About My Masters from ICT Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: The campus and classes were clean and green, but the campus area was small. For many events, management is done by seniors; every month we have at least one event. Wi-Fi facilities are provided, and a library is present in the college. We can bring any book from there. The hostel is big, but getting admission is challenging, given the merit list. As a South Indian here, food is different, but I have no other option.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Institute of Chemical Technology Mumbai (ICT).
reviews.review_text: The campus houses numerous clubs and societies. Several events are conducted throughout the year that benefit students in terms of sports. The ICT campus has badminton, cricket, and football courts. The hostel rooms are very clean and properly equipped with two, three, or four beds. Mess food is good in quality.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for research in Chemical Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent when it comes to classrooms, but other facilities like labs, libraries, and research centers are excellent. It has a huge library where students can also access the books online through their portals. If you are genuinely interested in research in the chemical domain, this is heaven for you. Also recently, the M Mokashi incubation center was inaugurated, where you can work on your startup ideas. The sports and games facility, mess and canteen are good.

reviews.review_heading: I have done my masters in chemistry. I am fully satisfied with my college, which includes facilities
reviews.review_text: 24 hour Wi-Fi facility is available, and there are 4 hostels, and every hostel has an individual study room and a 2nd floor library full of all required books and journals. The hostel facility is so far so good. We all know Mumbai is so costly, so accommodation is the big issue, so yes, it is a bit congested.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best college in Maharashtra.
reviews.review_text: It has the best infrastructure compared to other government colleges in Maharashtra. Classrooms are equipped with projectors and Wi-Fi. It has a dedicated IPC lab for computer-related courses. The chemical lab is the heart of this college. We get to perform many experiments during our course. The machinery and equipment in the labs are too costly. Some of them cost more than Rs. 50000000. We can enjoy the lab sessions and perform out-of-the-box experiments.

reviews_list.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied with the placements, faculty members, and HOD, sir.

reviews.review_heading: Good college because of good working environment, good infrastructure, and good placement.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college was good, and they provided sufficient equipment for our research work, like UV, IR, GC, HPLC, DSC, LC-MS, and NMR. All this equipment was sufficient for the research activities in pharmaceutical analysis, and we were free to use it.

reviews.review_heading: The college is worth for money if we put in full effort.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and classrooms are good enough. The infrastructure is well-built. It is very clean and good. It is very spacious enough for several purposes. Classrooms are very well-ventilated and disciplined. Daily cleaning of the rooms is done.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the placements, faculty members, and HOD, sir.
reviews.review_text: There is no campus life; the college has a small area and a very small canteen with limited entries. Basically, the college is like school with many restrictions, including limited leaves each year. Hindi-speaking people are very few. Basic facilities like internet, well-equipped labs with all necessary chemicals, and a library are available. Four girls stay in one room, which includes gym access, cupboards, hot/cold water, and drinking water. The college mess serves only vegetarian food, but th...

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college of pharmacy in Mysore.
reviews.review_text: It is a fully Wi-Fi-enabled campus with a well-equipped modern laboratory. The food served in the hostel is better. It has good environment, with a herbal garden. The canteen serves food at an affordable price. Our college provides health insurance and free treatment to students in JSS Hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good infrastructure and provides good education.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is not good. The building is under construction.

reviews.review_heading: JSS College of Pharmacy is a friendly college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided by JSS are top-notch. They have proper labs with the proper equipment and give health facilities to students with free insurance. The library is excellent with every type of pharmacy book and magazine. The campus is fully secured by CCTV cameras and Wi-Fi at every corner. Classrooms are digital. The quality of the hostel is good, except for the food provided by the mess. The canteen is quite expensive for students. There is every type of sport to play, like basketball, vo...

reviews.review_heading: JSS College of Pharmacy is a good place to study a professional course.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is good with Wi-Fi there in every section of the hostel. There is easy access to the internet and there are 2 badminton courts present in the hostel. There are other sports like basketball, volleyball and football also there. The labs and library are in good working order and are available to students at all times.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with a safe environment for everyone.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is average. The hostel has all the basic necessary commodities like Wi-Fi and a gym. Food quality is not great but is adjustable. The rooms are spacious with good ventilation. The campus has a lot of greenery with sports grounds for both boys and girls.

reviews.review_heading: The college has really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course/department are Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library etc. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is good, and the quality of food available in the mess is good. Medical facilities are available. Sports are conducted here.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good placements and has value for money.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is very strong on campus. There is proper mess food and rooms are cozy with 2,  3, and 7 seater rooms. Washrooms are very clean. The hostel and mess workers are friendly. There is privacy. There is a gym. Football, basketball, cricket, volleyball, and badminton can be played.

reviews.review_heading: I am proud to be a part of this college that is ranked 8 by NIRF.
reviews.review_text: Labs available are world-class at the moment with an exception of the pharmacognosy department which is still renovating its outlook. Labs in our college provide state-of-the-art infrastructure and are always willing to let you use all the instruments for your research purposes.

reviews.review_heading: Really good campus life.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi system is good and fast. Labs are big, spacious and filled with newly developed systems and devices. The library has a whole lot collection of books. Mess is average with average food. The canteen is not good, I would prefer the hostel mess over the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: This university gets 1st rank in all universities in India.
reviews.review_text: This college consists of a gym and other physical games centers, with a good ambiance. The college hostel is free from ragging and has a warden who is very friendly and helpful. The hostels are open till 8.00 PM, and for girls, it is 7.00 PM. The hostel mess menu has vegetarian food.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied and college gives lots of memories and infrastructure is so nice.
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure of college is very nice it provides a good atmosphere to students the college provide very speedy Wi-Fi and it has good and large library with every study material. Classroom are very large and with smart class.
Food in hostel is average and canteen provides a neat and good food it provide good medical facilities and it has basketball court.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with college faculty members, good placements and very good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: High-speed Wi-Fi is available on the college campus as well as in the college hostel. The infrastructure of the college and the hostel is quite good. Our college provides a vegetarian canteen. There is a basketball ball court and a small cricket court. Labs are good, and the lab assistants help students to do their work very well.

admission_process.title: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research S.A.S. Nagar Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, SAS Nagar admissionsare mainly entrance-based. Also known as NIPER SAS Nagar or NIPER Mohali, it is a public pharmaceutical research institute established in 2007. In 2019, the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) ranked NIPER SAS Nagar 3rdin pharmaceutical studies. The institute offers admission to programmes at the PG and doctoral levels.  offers programmes such as MPharm, MS (Pharm), MBA (Pharm) and MTech (Pharm) at PG level. Applications for all the programmes are invited in online mode only. At the doctoral level, the University offers a PhD in different disciplines of Pharmacy. NIPER SAS Nagar admission is entrance-based. Read the following article to learn all about the courses, admission criteria, and process for the institute.

NIPER SAS course admissionis subject to the fulfilment of the preset admission criteria. The institute accepts candidates primarily on an entrance basis. Some key highlights for the college are as follows:

This includes appearing for the institute-level test, followed by PI and other selection rounds. Selected students can then proceed accordingly. The application process is carried out online. Interested students can follow the step-by-stepNIPER SAS Nagar admission processmentioned below:
Step 1: Application

Visit the official website of the institute to apply for the desired programme by registering yourself online and filling out the application form duly. Submit the required documents and application fees to complete the process.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Students are selected based on their academic merit and entrance exam performance. Final selection is made on the basis of academic performance + entrance test scores + Personal Interview conducted by the college.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Once a seat is offered, students need to pay the admission fees to secure their spots at the college.

reviews.review_text: There are facilities like air-conditioned classrooms and a library. Hostels are clean and spacious having moderate food. There are sports, medical, and canteen facilities too. reviews.review_heading: One of the best reputed college.
reviews.review_text: At our college, top-quality facilities are offered for the pharmacy courses. All types of required facilities were given to the students here. At the college, classrooms and labs were spacious enough with proper seating. The college also has its own hostel. Hostel mess food was good quality.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great campus and provides good education as well as infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members in our college are completely experienced and will help students to attain knowledge and even guide in their respective field. Labs are with all required equipment and instruments for the successful completion of the project work. There are many sports and gymnasium available On the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has an unsatisfactory course curriculum.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college to grow.
reviews.review_text: Our college is spread over 130 acres with 4 hostels, and it has a well-established infrastructure. There are 3 hostels for boys and one for girls with individual rooms. reviews.review_heading: Excellent college for the students who wants to pursue their Masters.
reviews.review_text: Excellent buildings, well maintained hostel rooms, digital classrooms, well-equipped laboratories, especially the library in which they are having large number of books related to various subjects, Library is equipped with air conditioning and the books available to lent for free for few days.

reviews.review_heading: NIPER - The excellence of pharma.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructural facilities of our college are excellent. I think very few institutions have this type of infrastructure across India. The institute is comparable to various institutions in aboard as well. The campus is eco-friendly.

reviews.review_heading: Good Placement and really very nice infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Maximum facilities provided by NIPER that include Free Wi-Fi, Free hostel, swimming pool this facilites. In all labs AC are provided and lab for MS having well sophisticated instruments. In NIPER 5 hostel provided,  2 only boys, one for only girls, one for boys and girls and one married hostel is there. Hostels are well maintain and also mess facility provide in hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good place to flourish because of resources and faculty. But, huge scope to improve on placements.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure is one of the institutes asset. Infrastructure includes AC classrooms, huge labs with sufficient laboratory equipments and reagents, hostels, computer centre, library, Wi-Fi, ambulance, gym, playground, cafeteria, swimming pool and many other. I did not faced issue with infrastructure. Food available from hostel is palatable and of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: I don't like the seniors behavior with the juniors they treat them like a servant.
reviews.review_text: In my college, there is no Wi-Fi facility available. Only the first year students are allowed to go there, and from second year onwards, the students are shifted to different labs, with low-quality equipment and gadgets.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for graduation.
reviews.review_text: This campus has built over a humongous area of around 250-300 acres. The infrastructure is the best, and our college contains all the facilities which students ever expected. reviews.review_heading: The placements and infrastructure are good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SRM College of Pharmacy.

reviews.review_heading: SRM Pharmacy college Tamil Nadu.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college and very happy to study here.

reviews.review_heading: We didn't get any placement because of our staff didn't concentrate much on providing us placements.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides a good education.
reviews.review_text: Our college had excellent infrastructure. All classrooms were air-conditioned. Wi-Fi was available 24X7 in classrooms. Our labs were well maintained. Our college provided hostel facilities, which were quite affordable. The quality of the food was good.

reviews.review_heading: The college campus is very peaceful with good labs.
reviews.review_text: The labs are well-equipped with good and modern design. Classrooms are also well-equipped with smart boards. We don't have Wi-Fi service as of now, but have good sports facilities as we have our sports day. Canteen has a variety of options available to us.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Shobhaben Pratapbhai Patel School of Pharmacy and Technology Management (SPPSPTM).
reviews.review_text: The college has great labs. Almost costly equipment is available. The classrooms are air-conditioned and equipped with smart boards. The library is air-conditioned and the best in class. Mumbai is a crowded place, so you actually don't get hostels and sports facilities. But they make sure that everything is available, and the students have overall growth.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good course to get a great learning experience in pharmaceutical and managerial fields.
reviews.review_text: The campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and data present on the internet can be fetched at any given time to avoid wastage of time and to gain real-time information. A canteen and other facilities are always available round the clock, and the staff are well-coordinated.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities. The college has a great placement cell.
reviews.review_text: The college has a very good infrastructure. It provides all the facilities which are necessary for the students including, a well-equipped library, a public Wi-Fi, well established labs with all the equipments in an efficient working condition, air conditioned classrooms, etc. The quality of the facilities in the college is really good. The college also has two canteens which provide tasty and hygienic food for the students and are open throughout the working hours.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, nice infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Very good facilites, centrally air conditioned campus with a regularly updated library. Very appropriate Pharma labs for students, and smart board in every classroom makes it an event of fun learning. Annual sports day and college fests are a breath of fresh air amidst all the educational chaos.

reviews.review_heading: SPPSPTM Review by a Student.
reviews.review_text: Well maintained laboratories with properly equipped and knowledgeable staff. Excellently maintained classrooms with emphasis on hygiene. Proper GLP (Good Laboratory Practices) followed for sophisticated laboratories such as Biotechnology and Central Instrumentation Laboratory. The college also has provisions for a Pilot Plant and an Animal House following safe regulatory practices.

reviews.review_heading: Great placements and laboratories with good teaching quality.
reviews.review_text: Facilities include: Library, Wi-Fi, Smart board equipped classrooms, well maintained laboratories and top of the line lab equipments. The library has a Myriad books which the students need all the time. The building has very good canteens with good food and beverages.

reviews.review_heading: The curriculum is up to date with current trends & grooms the student for the real world.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is the best part of this institution. Every lab is well-equipped and well maintained. Same is the case with classroom infrastructure. The library has a good collection of pharma and management books. The major constraint for the college lies with respect to the space, be it with classrooms, which are spacious on the inside but are less in number because the entire school of pharmacy only spans over three floors of one wing of a building. Same is the case with the library. Beca...

reviews.review_heading: SPPSPTM is the best college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided by SPTM are amazing. Labs have all the pharmaceutical instruments for M.Pharms and PhD chemicals and safety instruments. Classrooms are air-conditioned with the facility of e-board, and the library is equipped with thousands of reference books. Canteen is the best part of the college, providing us with hygienic and delicious food.

reviews.review_heading: Overall good. Teachers are nice. Decent crowd and decent facilities for a college.
reviews.review_text: Pretty decent facilities. We just hoped we would get a separate canteen for our college because it gets a bit difficult for us to go up and down within the span of half and hour to have our lunch otherwise everything is pretty good. The labs are pretty nice and they've new and really good machines.

reviews.review_heading: An institute for learning and overall development of a student .
reviews.review_text: Our college has an environment that is conducive for education. Classrooms are spacious and labs are well-equipped with the latest technology instruments. Classrooms are fully air conditioned and have smart boards which enhances our learning experience. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled. Our college's canteen is good. It provides good food at not very high a cost. Library has ample books that are required in our curriculum and it stays open till 8pm so students can study even after college hours.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides great faculty members, and laboratories.
reviews.review_text: Our college has well-equipped laboratories, with all the required apparatus for carrying out the prescribed experimental work. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled and the library boasts of a vast collection of reference books, E-books, and research journals.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best pharmacy college in Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: The college has an amazing infrastructure, Wi-Fi, properly functioning smart boards and projectors, auditorium, library with e-library facility, air-conditioners, hygienic canteen facility, a pilot plant, etc. Laboratories are well-equipped, and classrooms are also clean.

reviews.review_heading: An amalgamation of best courses for pharmacy professionals.
reviews.review_text: It is a completely Wi-Fi enabled campus with smartboard technology in all classrooms. The library has books from all sorts of disciplines. The food available is very pocket-friendly as compared to the Mumbai prices. The laboratories are equipped with world-class equipment like Mass Spectroscopy, UV-vis, ATR, Zeta Sizer, DSC, HPLC, etc.

admission_overview.title: LPU Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: LPU admission 2026 is mainly entrance-based and a multi-step process starting with application followed by selection rounds, and result declaration. The Lovely Professional University (LPU) offers more than 300 degree and diploma courses at the UG, PG, and doctoral levels along with several distance learning courses via the LPU Centre for Distance & Online Education. The application process for the university can be completed online. LPU conducts LPUNEST as the in-house entrance and scholarship exam for its courses in fileds of Engineering, Agriculture, Management, Law, Design, Pharmacy, Architecture & Planning, and more. While LPUNEST is widely accepted by the university, if students have valid scores of other national-level entrance exams, such JEE Main Part 2, NATA, CAT, MAT, XAT, etc, they are exempted from appearing for LPUNEST for selective courses. Those who want to improve their scholarships can apply for the LPUNEST exam as well.

This entrance exam is conducted for admission to more than 150 courses at the UG and PG levels. A general eligibility for courses offered by Lovely Professional University is: In case a student has valid score in other accepted exams including JEE Main/ NATA/ CAT/ MAT, etc., they can directly proceed with the remaining selection rounds.

faqs.question: Will I get a direct admission in LPU with 65 % marks in Class 12?
faqs.answer: LPU does not offer direct admission. However, admission to few courses is merit-based.  Aspirants scoring a 65% aggregate have a good chance of getting admission in LPU. Candidates seeking admission must visit the official website of the university to apply online. To apply for LPU, aspirants need to register for LPUNEST for admission to undergraduate and postgraduate courses. LPU admission to most of the courses is based on LPUNEST score. However, national-level entrance exam scores are also accepted for admission to BA LLB (Hons), MBA, BTech, etc. Candidates must complete Class 12 for UG courses and graduation for PG courses. The selection rounds are followed by counselling and document verification.

faqs.question: Is LPU entrance exam hard?
faqs.answer: LPUNEST is a national-level exam conducted by LPU for admission to various courses. LPUNEST forms the basis of eligibility for some programmes and also for the scholarship programmes. The amount of scholarship is determined by the marks and rank obtained by candidates in the exam. LPUNEST exam pattern elucidates the scheme of the question paper. Candidates seeking admission through LPUNEST must check the exam pattern prior to starting the preparation. LPUNEST exam pattern imparts details like total number of question, subjects, marking scheme, exam duration, etc. The entrance test is neither hard nor easy. Candidates must prepare well to score the qualifying marks in the entrance exam.

faqs.question: What would be the fees if you take a direct admission in the LPU?
faqs.answer: The fee is same for regular and direct admission. LPU fees changes for every course. The top LPU courses along with fee details are mentioned below:Course NameTotal FeeBTechINR 4.5 lakh - INR 16 lakhMBAINR 1.6 lakh - INR 10 lakhBBAINR 3.2 lakh - 9.6 lakhBCAINR 1.5 lakh - 7.2 lakhMCAINR 1.2 lakh - 4.8 lakhNote:This information is gathered from official website and is subject to change.

faqs.question: How can students get admission to LPU directly?
faqs.answer: LPU direct admissions are not possible for many courses. Students who wish to get admission must follow the application process given below:Register yourselfAppear for the LPUNEST exam.Once the results are announced, you have to choose a courseTake part in the counselling session and seat allotment.Perform well in the interview round.Fill the admission form and pay INR 10,000 initially.Submit all the necessary documents and pay the remaining fee.

placement_data.title: Lovely Professional University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The highest package offered during LPU placements 2025 stood at INR 2.5 crore per annum and the second highest package stood at INR 1.03 crore per annum. Both packages were offered to the students of BTech Robotics & Automation batch 2025. The average salary offered to the top 25% students stood at INR 10.23 LPA. More than 2,225 recruiters visited the LPU campus and offered over 6,000 job to the students. The top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Accenture, CISCO, TCS, Capgemini, Cognizant, Autodesk, Infosys, Trident, JP Morgan, E&Y, Bosch , etc.

Earlier, the students of the BTech batch 2024 secured the highest package of INR 53 LPA . A total of 1,611 recruiters participated in the placement process and prsented over 7,400 jobs to the students. Microsoft, Google, Infosys, L&T, Amazon, HCL, IBM, TCS, ICICI Bank, etc were among the top recruiters.

faqs.answer: LPU offers decent placements annually for courses like BBA, BCA, MBA, MCA BTech, etc. The LPU average package offered to the top 25% students of the batch 2025 stood at INR 10.23 LPA and the top 10% was INR 12.3 LPA. faqs.question: What is LPU fees for BTech?
faqs.answer: The total fee for BTech is INR 4.5 lakh -INR 16 lakh. The fee is calculated based on the semester fee. Admission to BTech course is based on LPUNEST or CUET UG score. After completion of the selection rounds, shortlisted aspirants need to pay the course fee to confirm their admission. Candidates are first required to register with an application fee for LPUNEST. The exam fee for LPUNEST is INR 1,000 for males and INR 500 for females.

nirf.description:
LPU has received strong ranks by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category. Provided parameters including, Teaching, Graduation Outcome, Inclusivity and Research, the institute is ranked in a good position as compared to other institutes by the NIRF 2025. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown a fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, LPU fell 4 ranks to #49 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
One can observe that within the category of 'University', the institute's ranking has fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, LPU fell 4 ranks to #31 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Engineering' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, LPU climbed 2 ranks to #48 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been seen that in the 'Management' category, the institute's ranks have shown a decreasing trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year.
