reviews.review_heading: It's all about your choice for this MBA course.
reviews.review_text: All the requirements are there. The tools needed to get it. Classrooms and labs have requirements. Wi-Fi is available on campus and in the hotel. The hotels are very good with facilities. The food in the mess is also very good. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LPU - Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: I can't say that the infrastructure is awesome. Our course blocks are clean and well-managed inside. The outside look is average. But the winning facilities are top grade. There is a Good Wi-Fi speed, which is nearly 10 GB per second, but in working hours, it is 2 to 3 GB per second. It is the same in the hostel as well.

reviews.review_heading: I’m strongly satisfied and worth it.
reviews.review_text: 5G Wi-Fi, well-furnished classroom, benches with charging switch, AC, projector and whiteboards. Library with more than 10,000+ books, the latest computer labs, water supplies with a watercooler, garden with sitting benches, greenery flowers, food courts, terrace canteen, malls, sports complex. Hostel rooms are well-established rooms, AC, non-AC (cooler will be there), water cooler in every hostel floor, exercise machines are located in hostel premises, friendly warden, canteen in every hostel, ...

reviews.review_heading: Best college with a good atmosphere and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: I'm from B.Tech CSE, and the infrastructure and Wi-Fi are fantastic. The classrooms are maintained very well. The library has a good number of books and a good place to study, and also a hostel is very good. All facilities are there, like games, indoor and outdoor. Good mess food, and there is a medical emergency like having a university hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are not up to the mark, huge opportunities available only if you study hard.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and the hostel were very good. The hostel security is also good, various food will be served for north and south indians students, whatever they want but bit expensive for the hostel and food. The course and the labs were very good to use.

reviews.review_heading: LPU, choosing it is up to you.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good, you get Wi-Fi facility at good speed in both college and hostel. Library is amazing, has a lot of books and even a good place to study; silence is a must. Classrooms are decent. Hostel facilities are decent. Rooms get cleaned often. Mess food might be good some days but will start to hate it. Canteen is good. College is really outstanding when it comes to sports. Inter-hostel tournaments happen. Olympic size swimming pool exists. Two big cricket grounds. Sports complex exists wher...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty, good placements in 2022, and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the university is in top-notch condition. This is the biggest university in India. All labs and library are well-equipped with air conditioning. Classrooms are well-maintained. Food is ok for South people, but it looks like somewhat difficult to survive on this food. They provide 24X7 medical facility.

reviews.review_heading: Reviewing facts about Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: For my course, the facilities are quite good. The university is providing computer labs, Wi-Fi and big classrooms. The library is also there, which is very huge and consists of a wide range of books. The hostel is also decent, and the rooms are always clean. Mess food is okay. Medical facilities are available at any time.

reviews.review_heading: Very good infrastructure and facilities. Good placements, campus life, and facilities are excellent.
reviews.review_text: Facilities of the classes are very good. Labs are also very good, and library facilities are excellent. Wi-Fi is good, but sometimes, due to the large number of students, the network goes down. Hostel facilities are very good. Mess food and canteen are also very good. Medical support is available 24x7. For sports, we have an auditorium where you can play games and sports.

reviews.review_heading: The best infrastructure this college has, alongwith very good placements.
reviews.review_text: On our campus, all facilities are very good. But sometimes we have Wi-Fi speed issues in some blocks, not in labs. The library is open from 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM. Classrooms are digital for every class, we need a laptop mainly for CSE. Faculty are good. In the hostel, most of the facilities are very good, but a few times we have issues with the electricity bill at the end of the year. The gym is present inside the hostels, which is also free. The mess food is good in taste and unlimited. But the m...

reviews.review_heading: The college has beautiful infrastructure, good facilities, and strong placements.
reviews.review_text: The college had number one facilities and beautiful infrastructure. The classrooms for my course were hygienic and clean. Every block contained a library, and free Wi-Fi was available 24/7. The quality of food was not ideal for South Indian students. But overall, it was very good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college with excellent infrastructure and strong placement support.
reviews.review_text: B.Tech, BBA, MBA, BCA, and MCA courses are offered. Labs are available, and Wi-Fi is available 24/7 in the hostel and college. The library is very good, with seven floors. Each floor can seat 100–120 students. Food is very good, and three types of food are available. South Indian, North Indian, and combined. Non-veg food is not allowed.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Lovely Institute of Technology, PharmacyReviewed on 17 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: You get placed according to your capacity and capabilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, smart classes, libraries, and even a hospital inside the campus. The campus is even bigger and has its own many areas and food courts. It has many facilities, like an indoor stadium, a pool, many grounds, and even a helipad for helicopter landing.

reviews.review_heading: Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Amazed with the college infrastructure as they were offering a number of courses in various sections. For all the sections, 80 percent of seats were enrolled directly and the rest of the enrollment was through management. Fees should vary between direct admission and management quota students. Sports and games were played by us regularly as they were part of our schedule.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LPU  Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: Visiting the hostel rooms seriously made me feel comfortable and much more peaceful in the day to day routine. The perfect environment allowed us to have meaningful college days without any distractions. The fee fixed for all the services was not affordable to all.

The placement of our college is not bad, and they give the other best efforts to place the student in the best organisation.

likes.text: There is a library in every department and a huge central library in our university where any required book can be found.
It has well-built classrooms, laboratories, playgrounds, an auditorium, etc., Our university even has an on-campus hospital and a shopping mall i.e. Unimall.
Our college has great hostel infrastructure, different sharing rooms with attached washrooms, mess, canteen, open gym in park and badminton court inside the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: An excellent college choice.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is excellent. It has classrooms with projectors and 10 to 12 well-equipped labs out of which 5 to 6 PG labs are fully air conditioned. It has a well-structured library with at least 10,000 books. The hostel facilities are great too. It has free Wi-Fi. It's kept clean all the time. Hostel has lifts which works 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements with more than 70%.
reviews.review_text: Labs were very big and all materials required for each experiment were present in that lab. All the students got a chance to do and learn all experiments. Digital library was one of the best advantages of this college. All the books mentioned in the syllabus were present in the library. Hostel was very hygienic and bathroom facilities were very good. Food was also good and healthy. Yearly college conducted arts fest and sports fest.

reviews.review_heading: It is pretty good and satisfactory.
reviews.review_text: The hostel has good infrastructure but less cleanliness compared to other hostels. The food services are also not on par with those of other hostels. The college infrastructure is pretty good. Classrooms are well-lit and have good technologies like projectors and screens.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is good, but hostel facilities are not up to mark.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good and developed labs for experiments. We have developed machinery to use. Our classrooms have computers, and libraries are filled with books that are relevant to the topics taught. The hostel conditions are average. The food mess is average. Wi-Fi is not available in the hostel for students.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college. Opportunities available here should be used appropriately.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms and labs are very well maintained. Classrooms are air conditioned. College computer lab with internet facility is available. There is a big sports ground for extra activities. College arts and sports fest are held every year. College hostel is very good. There are separate hostel for boys and girls. Both hostels are well secure.

reviews.review_heading: Review about the ASP Kochi.
reviews.review_text: College has good infrastructure and facilities. It provides all the basic necessities. Talking more about facilities, our college provides a very good lab and library, which are very essential for a pharmacy scholar. Our library has all necessary books, including the latest editions of pharmacopoeia and other important pharmacy-related books. The college also provides proper basic needs like food, mess, canteen, etc.

reviews.review_heading: D.Pharma at Amrita in a nutshell.
reviews.review_text:
We have 1 computer lab for undergraduate students and 1 other lab for PG and Ph.D. students. Both of them has AC. The PG labs has AC and they are pretty cool.
Undergraduate labs don't have AC.
The hostel is pretty strict.
Mess food is bad; only vegetarian option is available. Medical facilities are great; an ambulance is available 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in India for pharmacy course .
reviews.review_text: The college offers a well-maintained lab with qualified lab assistance, a spacious classroom with smart screens and a library with a minimum of 6,000 books and various journal papers. The hostel facility is also available with a decent meal menu. Wi-Fi, a gym, a coffee shop, play courts and study rooms are available in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good for studies but not for events.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure provided is the best. The labs, classrooms have good facilities and are spacious. The hostel facilities are too good. The rooms were spacious, and the bathrooms are clean. The rooms were shared by 3-4 persons. The food provided is okay but could be improved.

reviews.review_heading: Life in Amrita School of Pharmacy.
reviews.review_text: The lab facilities available in the college are very good and well-maintained. Various equipment is available in the lab. Free Wi-Fi is available for hostellers. Students can access two libraries, the college library and the central library. The food available in the mess is not up to the mark.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the curriculum and placements, but lacks in infrastructure and teaching skills.

review_content.Placements: The percent of students who get placed in my course is quite decent. The highest package offered is 1.2 crores per annum. The average package offered ranges from 7-8 LPA, which is good. Top companies like EY, Adobe, and Flipkart visit the college every year. The internship ratio is not so good. Companies offer different roles and mainly focus on software engineers.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the course department and hostel is not up to date as there is much rush in the building every time. In hostels, there is no lift. There is a big line whenever we go to the mess. The quality of food is not up to the mark. It also provides us with Wi-Fi and medical facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: No good return on investment in this university for all the students.

review_content.Placements: Almost 20% of students will get placed in 2025. The highest package is 1.7 crore, the average is around 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The top recruitment companies are TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. About internships, mostly good internships are available for students through off-campus placements, while very few students get on-campus internships. I have no idea about the top roles.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wifi speed is not very good, but can be said to be okay. Labs are decent, classrooms are not good; benches in the last rows are broken in many classrooms. The library is decent and provides an environment for studies. If someone's faculty is good, then he or she will get good marks in practicals, and if someone's is bad, then better luck next time.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Campus life & career-ready.

review_content.Placements: Around 60% of the students get placed per year. The placements kick start right from the 6th semester. My placements will start in Feb 2026. It depends on your skills, your personality, and your communication skills. The average package offered to CSE students is 8 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are not that good personally. The rooms are small, and all of them are either 4 or 5-seater rooms with only coolers provided. The AC's are provided to only international students. The mess food is very bland. We have a dispensary with all facilities available. The classrooms are fully equipped, and libraries are well-built with proper infrastructure and Wi-Fi provided.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Good placement and perfect study place.

review_content.Placements: In my course, approximately 85 percent of students get placed in various companies. The highest salary in previous years is 57LPA with a average package of 7LPA for general placements. Top recruiting companies are Adobe, ServiceNow, Microsoft etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Top class infrastructure, clean and clear buildings with labs for each case/condition. Perfect space for letting our energy out. Wi-Fi facility, libraries in each building block. Canteens, food services, water supply at every end possible, Medical services available 24 hours and emergency services as well.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Chandigarh University has strong placements, global exposure and industry ready learning.

review_content.Placements: Batch 2021 to 2025 has the highest placement record of around 90 to 95 percent. The highest package was around 1.7 crore per annum and the average package is around 8 to 10 LPA. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Cognizant, IBM etc. Top roles offered are Data Analyst and AI and ML.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure has developed a lot from previous times to the current time like including multipurpose rooms, Apple Labs, and IoT Labs. The facilities in the hostels are quite impressive with washing machines on each floor and the mess is clean too. The games and sports are organized every year. People from other universities even come to participate in these sports.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Com. (Hons.) in Advanced Cost & Management Accounting (ITP) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: There are many cafe areas on the campus. Scholarship structure is also very good.

review_content.Placements: Mostly students from the previous batch have been placed in good companies. They get a package above 3.5 LPA. Many opportunities are available because they organize many competitions you can be part of the event committee too. Overall good opportunity .
review_content.Infrastructure: A fully Wi-Fi campus is provided. Hostels are good, and my department classes also have air conditioning. You have options for both attached and common washrooms. Great opportunity and all the hostels also have stocked shops from where you can buy daily use things.

review_summary.college_name: Chandigarh University (CU) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the curriculum and placements, but lacks in infrastructure and teaching skills.

content.Placements: The percent of students who get placed in my course is quite decent. The highest package offered is 1.2 crores per annum. The average package offered ranges from 7-8 LPA, which is good. Top companies like EY, Adobe, and Flipkart visit the college every year. The internship ratio is not so good. Companies offer different roles and mainly focus on software engineers.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the course department and hostel is not up to date as there is much rush in the building every time. In hostels, there is no lift. There is a big line whenever we go to the mess. The quality of food is not up to the mark. It also provides us with Wi-Fi and medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: No good return on investment in this university for all the students.

content.Placements: Almost 20% of students will get placed in 2025. The highest package is 1.7 crore, the average is around 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The top recruitment companies are TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. About internships, mostly good internships are available for students through off-campus placements, while very few students get on-campus internships. I have no idea about the top roles.
content.Infrastructure: Wifi speed is not very good, but can be said to be okay. Labs are decent, classrooms are not good; benches in the last rows are broken in many classrooms. The library is decent and provides an environment for studies. If someone's faculty is good, then he or she will get good marks in practicals, and if someone's is bad, then better luck next time.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Campus life & career-ready.

content.Placements: Around 60% of the students get placed per year. The placements kick start right from the 6th semester. My placements will start in Feb 2026. It depends on your skills, your personality, and your communication skills. The average package offered to CSE students is 8 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are not that good personally. The rooms are small, and all of them are either 4 or 5-seater rooms with only coolers provided. The AC's are provided to only international students. The mess food is very bland. We have a dispensary with all facilities available. The classrooms are fully equipped, and libraries are well-built with proper infrastructure and Wi-Fi provided.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good placement and perfect study place.

content.Placements: In my course, approximately 85 percent of students get placed in various companies. The highest salary in previous years is 57LPA with a average package of 7LPA for general placements. Top recruiting companies are Adobe, ServiceNow, Microsoft etc.
content.Infrastructure: Top class infrastructure, clean and clear buildings with labs for each case/condition. Perfect space for letting our energy out. Wi-Fi facility, libraries in each building block. Canteens, food services, water supply at every end possible, Medical services available 24 hours and emergency services as well.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Chandigarh University has strong placements, global exposure and industry ready learning.

content.Placements: Batch 2021 to 2025 has the highest placement record of around 90 to 95 percent. The highest package was around 1.7 crore per annum and the average package is around 8 to 10 LPA. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Cognizant, IBM etc. Top roles offered are Data Analyst and AI and ML.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure has developed a lot from previous times to the current time like including multipurpose rooms, Apple Labs, and IoT Labs. The facilities in the hostels are quite impressive with washing machines on each floor and the mess is clean too. The games and sports are organized every year. People from other universities even come to participate in these sports.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: No, direct admission is not valid for any of the UG & PG courses at Chandigarh University. The university conducts CUCET exam to offer admission to eligible candidates. All the aspirants must qualify for this exam with a valid score. The admission process starts with CUCET registrations. Candidates can check out the exam pattern and CUCET syllabus to prepare for the exam, which will help them score well.

faqs.question: Is CUCET compulsory for Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Chandigarh University conducts Chandigarh University Common Entrance Test (CUCET) for admission to all of its UG and PG courses. This is a common entrance exam that is applicable for admission of candidates in every stream such as Management, Humanities, Science, Commerce, Engineering, etc. To get admission to any of the courses offered at Chandigarh University, students have to apply for this exam on the official website of CUCET and appear for the exam. This exam is conducted in an online mode in two phases. For admission to any of the courses, there are two decisive factors that are considered by the university for admission. These are eligibility criteria and CUCET scores.

faqs.question: What are the steps for Chandigarh University admissions?
faqs.answer: Students can refer the steps given below to complete the Chandigarh University admissions:Apply and register for CUCET at the official CU website.Choose an examination date for the Chandigarh University Eligibility and Scholarship Test as per your convenience.After the CUCET results are out, students can submit their applications for admission and availing the merit-based scholarship.

hostel_campus.college_name: Chandigarh University (CU) Infrastructure: Campus

highlights: Good Power Supply: The hostel has a 24*7 power supply with a supportive power backup for the smooth functioning of the regular tasks and activities.

Free Wi-Fi Internet Services: Hostels are provided with free Wi-Fi services with good speed. The internet services are easily accessible with login credentials provided to students staying in the hostel rooms.
Well-furnished common rooms: There is a 24*7 well-furnished room available to play indoor board games. The hostel also has a separate TV room for relaxation time in the free hours.

Gymnasium: For fitness freaks, Gym facilities are also provided to students. Many modern equipment and special trainers are provided for the proper guidance. The gym is open at particular times and has enough space to accommodate around 10-25 students.

Well-equipped reading rooms: To study with focus, students get separate reading rooms. These rooms maintain the ambiance of libraries and facilitate resources such as newspapers, magazines, and other reading materials.
Night Canteen & Tuck Shops: To provide groceries and essential items, tuck shops are available inside the hostels. There are canteen also available, which remains open till night.
Salon: For girls' students, a salon is given inside the hostel premises that provides all the essential services.

Visitors and Guest Room: For special visitors from the side of students’ families, separate guest rooms are available with clean and attached bathrooms. To book these rooms, prior notice must be given to authorities.

hostel.description: Chandigarh University campus has separate hostels for boys and girls with an attached mess. All the hostels have basic amenities like water purifiers, common room, gym, salon, recreation room, mess, TV, laundry services, security, and surveillance system.

Well-furnished common rooms: There is a 24*7 well-furnished room available to play indoor board games. The hostel also has a separate TV room for relaxation time in the free hours.

Well-equipped reading rooms: To study with focus, students get separate reading rooms. These rooms maintain the ambiance of libraries and facilitate resources such as newspapers, magazines, and other reading materials.
Night Canteen & Tuck Shops: To provide groceries and essential items, tuck shops are available inside the hostels. There are canteen also available, which remains open till night.
Salon: For girls' students, a salon is given inside the hostel premises that provides all the essential services.

Visitors and Guest Room: For special visitors from the side of students’ families, separate guest rooms are available with clean and attached bathrooms. To book these rooms, prior notice must be given to authorities.

reviews.review_heading: I do not regret taking admission here, and it is very good.

college_info.college_name: Chitkara College of Pharmacy, Chitkara University, Chandigarh

highlights.summary:
Approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), Chitkara College of Pharmacy, Punjab is one of the institutions under UGC-approved Chitkara University, which is popular as one of the best private universities in North India. The University has accreditations and memberships with several national and international bodies.

Chitkara University has a total of eleven institutions under it, which are listed below:

Chitkara College of Pharmacy has been ranked 38 for Pharmacy by NIRF 2020. The College offers full-time courses in the areas of Pharmacy, which include DPharm, BPharm, PharmD, PharmD (Post Baccalaureate), BPharm (Practice), MPharm and MSc Pharmacovigilance & Clinical Research.

It has strong industry collaborations with various organisations like Fortis Healthcare, Sankara Eye Care and Synapse Physio Pvt. Ltd. The course curriculum of the College is a combination of theory, practical and clinical exposure. Each of the faculty members holds a master’s degree in respective areas.

Chitkara College of Pharmacy provides various facilities for the research in Pharmaceutical Sciences like HPLC analysis, dissolution and other formulation studies, analysis of samples for infrared and UV spectrophotometric data, pre-clinical evaluation and analytical method development

Here is a list of some quick highlights related to Chitkara College of Pharmacy:

Candidates can get admissions through online and offline. Chitkara College of Pharmacy admissions are merit-based and the eligible candidates are called over for the interview by the School/ University for further process at the campus/ office. The fast facts related to Chitkara College of Pharmacy admission process are mentioned below:

Read more: Chitkara College of Pharmacy Admission Process

The College offers a total of seven programmes at UG, PG and doctoral level in various specialisations in full-time mode. The highlights about Chitkara College of Pharmacy courses are mentioned below:

The eligibility criteria for courses offered by Chitkara College of Pharmacy is mentioned below:

Read more: Chitkara College of Pharmacy Courses

Chitkara College of Pharmacy placements are conducted at Chitkara University campus. Over 50 recruiters visit for the recruitment process for Pharmacy programmes every year. The top recruiters who participated during Chitkara College of Pharmacy placements include Blue Chip Multinational and National Pharma companies, such as Ranbaxy Labs Ltd., Eli Lilly, Cipla, Pfizer Ltd., etc.

individual_reviews.title: It has great infrastructure and placement facilities.

content.Placements: Around 80-90% of students get placed. The highest package is 10 LPA, and the lowest package is 4 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are Sunpharma, Cipla, Zydus, etc. Around 90% of students get internships in companies like Sunpharma, etc. The top roles offered are researcher, drug regulatory, drug inspector, medical shops, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a great infrastructure and proper facilities like labs are fully equipped and classrooms are neat and clean. It has a proper air-conditioned library with every book related to our course. Hostel facilities are good. Rooms are clean and good. The hostel food is also good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Extremely amazing ambience.

content.Placements: A large number of students get placement, but the salary as a beginner is quite low. Approximately a package of 4-5 Lacs. Big companies like Sunpharma, Cipla, etc., come and interview the students. Teachers play a major role in helping students crack the interview.
content.Infrastructure: Teachers are well-educated, along with practical knowledge being provided. Even labs are well-equipped with educated lab technicians. Hostels are well-maintained with proper services like laundry, daily cleaning, night attendance, food, etc. Mess food is okay.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Great Place to Study.

content.Placements: Top recruiting companies include Cipla Healthcare and Indswift Derabassi. The top roles offered are in Senior Management, Industrial Approach in Production, Quality Control, and Quality Assurance. The average package starts from 12 lakhs to 18 lakhs per annum! It's a nice place.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are well maintained and fully modernized. The classrooms are air-conditioned with Wi-Fi provision, and a well-equipped library is available. The quality of food is okayish but nutritious, and the mess has a different menu altogether. Medical facilities are also provided.

Pharmacy was 8 Lacs, the average was 3.80 lacs, and the lowest was 3.20 lacs. There are many companies which offer placement: Dr. Reddy, RANBAXY, SUNPHARMA, etc. All the students got the internship .

review_summary.college_name: Amity University Noida UP Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Clinical Psychology (Honours / Research) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied because of the campus life, faculty, and services given by this university.

content.Placements: Placements are usually good at Amity University. Good recruiting companies come to our college for placements, and high packages are provided. In some cases, when the placements are not provided, the students can also find job opportunities outside also.
content.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is too good. For my course, the building is a little underdeveloped, but it is soon going to be developed as promised by the faculty. Food, medicine, and sports facilities are really good in this university. The hostel is also good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Engineering at Amity University, Noida, is effective and it only has the fame.

content.Placements: I would like to say that approximately 75 percent of students got the placements. If they are well prepared with the skills required in current technology. There are lots of companies visiting the campus for placement. If you have good skills, you can get a placement easily. There are many roles, such as GET, Software Engineer, and sales, also.
content.Infrastructure: If I talk about Amity, the best thing that they are providing is the infrastructure, the campus is fully AC and fully Wi-Fi-enabled. They have a good number of labs for practicals in the Computer Science subject. They have a special AI lab which has been built in collaboration with NVIDIA. In my college, there are a number of canteens and cafeterias. From then on, the best one is the Mega Bite named canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Information Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure and a good course curriculum.

content.Placements: Around 35% of students from our course get placed through campus recruitment drives. The highest package offered is 8 LPA, reflecting strong technical roles. The lowest package is 1 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Dell and Coforge, which hire students for technical support roles. Approximately 70 percent of students secure internships. The most common role offered is IT technician.
content.Infrastructure: The department has well-maintained infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. It has properly equipped computer labs, and a well-stocked library that supports academic learning. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms. It also has decent mess and canteen food. Along with adequate medical support, and access to sports facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Average opinion about the college.

content.Placements: Out of 11 students interested in placements, 3 have been successfully placed through campus placements. The highest package till now is 7.5 LPA, and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my course include BSES, Vanderlande, Schlumberger, Kirloskar Oil Engines, and LiuGong. 50 percent of students got internships through college support in companies like Dixon Technologies Ltd. and Nuremberg Ltd. Top roles offered include graduate engineer trainee and associate sales engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi does not work properly. Labs are well-equipped with all the necessary infrastructure and machines. Classrooms are a bit messy. The library is well-equipped with good infrastructure and books. I found the mess quite hygienic, but the taste of the food is not up to the mark. Sports facilities and grounds are average, with nothing special.

individual_reviews.course: M.Pharm. in Pharmaceutics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great campus and teachers but dissatisfied with labs and placements.

content.Placements: The average package of 3 LPA can be expected. Only one company comes here that offers 8 LPA, but it takes 2 to 3 students only rest all are placed at the above mentioned package. The company comes, and you will give interview and sometimes they are online as well.
content.Infrastructure: Amity is best in terms of infrastructure, classrooms and library but lab in the pharmacy department definitely needs an upgrade. They are really good in other departments like biotechnology or chemistry, etc. The classroom teaching takes place with a projector and ppts are provided as notes. Hostels are available but the cost is very high and food is not included in the hostel fee and rooms are small as well.

Candidates seeking for getting admission to UG/ PG courses of the university must go through a detailedAmity University Noida admission process. To admit the right candidates, the university selects students based on selection criteria, which include filling theAmity Noida application form, qualifying for the selection rounds and paying for theAmity University Noida feesat the time of final admission.
Interested in Amity University Noida course admissions? Check out the elaborated steps for theAmity University admission processin the following section:
Amity Noida Application Process

The Amity University admission process begins by filling an application form on the official website of Amity University Noida. If candidates wish to apply for more than one programme, they need to fill out a separate form for each course by paying an application fee ofINR 1,500each. The new users are required to generate login credentials and fill an online application form with all the relevant details and documents and submit the form on the admission portal of Amity Noida.
Amity Noida Selection Process

Amity Noida admissions are both merit and entrance-based depending on the course. Students need to meet clear both criteria to get admission. The selection criteria for Amity Noida programmes are as below:
Note: The personal interview can be either video-based or in person as per the university's directions.
Amity Noida Final Offer Letter

After the completion of all the selection rounds, the final result will be declared. The information concerning selection will be communicated on the admission microsite as well as via Email and SMS. Selected candidates will get an admission letter along with important information such as semester fee, class commencement date, time, venue of the course, allotment of a hostel (If applied), scholarship (If any) and the list of documents required at the time of joining. Candidates also have to pay for a certain amount as per theAmity University Noida fees structureto secure their seat.

faqs.question: What is the fee for MBA at Amity Noida?
faqs.answer: Amity Noida offers MBA course with many specialisations. Those who secure admission to this course must pay Amity University Noida MBA fee at the time of admission. The total amount of Amity Noida MBA fee for both years ranges between INR 6.4 lakh - INR 26.4 lakh. This fee ranges contains the fee for all MBA specialisations. It may include various components including Tuition Fee. Students also have to pay an additional amount of INR 1,500 at the time of registration. The lowest fee range is given for MBA in Agriculture & Food Business and the highest fee is for MBA (General) course. However, this information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. Students are advised to visit the official website to know more about Amity Noida MBA fee structure.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good and affordable medical college.

content.Placements: Above 60% in the CBSE board in 12 the standard in the medical stream was the primary requirement for admission. B.Pharma has the highest percentage. They have collaborative programs with AIIMS. Internships are necessary in 6th year. Roles offered laboratory, head laboratory technician, and data manager.
content.Infrastructure: Excellent infrastructure facilities with healthy and sanitary surroundings. There are comfortable classrooms equipped with smart boards with good ventilation. Library is equipped with a variety of books for different courses all necessary books available in the library. College has all the necessary equipment.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am fully satisfied, and the infrastructure is more happening in 1 or 2 years.

content.Placements: Almost 70 to 80% of students from M. Pharm and MBA get placements. Some B. Pharma also gets placed. Companies like Cipla, Sun Pharma, and Dr. Reddy Laboratories are top recruiters. Roles offered include analysis, research, and development. The highest package is around 12 to 13 LPA, while the lowest is 4 to 5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Very nice infrastructure, well-maintained laboratories, and a fully air-conditioned lecture room. A big library in which all the author books are easily available. The hostel is very neat and clean within walking distance from the main academic building. Mess is also very nice.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy(BPT) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of BPT course in Delhi Pharmaceutical Science and Research.

content.Placements: Placement in BPT courses is quite irrelevant. The best you can get by doing BPT is postings in hospitals like Safdarjung and others. By the time you come into 3rd year, you are given postings in OPDs and hospitals so that you can apply what you have read in the last 2 years.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are quite spacious, but time-to-time renovation needs to be done. Since the college is under the Delhi government, delay in maintaining the infrastructure is a normal thing. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel. One Mother Dairy shop is there at the entrance on the right side of the college. The hostel is affordable.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the college.

content.Placements: No students are placed hence no average, low, and high package. Companies are Lal Path Labs, Radcliffe, Labs Max, and Labs Tata 1mg. All students get to do internships in government hospitals. Most of the roles are of phlebotomy and blood-urine testing. Do not expect much from this college, find internships on own to gain skills.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure in the hostel is good enough. We get Wi-Fi facility. Library might start soon after renovation. We have a gym with adequate equipment. There is a mother dairy for milk and snacks. Medical officers with MBBS degrees are there for health-related problems.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of Delhi Pharmaceutical Sciences and Research University.

content.Placements: Approximately 85% of students get placed. The highest salary package offered is 5 LPA with better skills in laboratory technology. The average salary package offered is 3 LPA for the Medical Laboratory Technology students. About 70% of the students got an internship from the college in different companies. The top roles offered are to do the best in medical laboratory technology and to understand the field.
content.Infrastructure: There is free Wi-Fi in the college for students of all UG and PG courses. Labs available for all B.Pharma and BMLT students are well-organised. Classrooms are also good. The library is more good and a peaceful place in the college. The hostel facility is also good. The rooms of the hostel are of moderate size with furniture attached. The mess food is okay.

paragraphs: DPSRU admission processbegins with registration for the preferred programme. The application process usually starts in May and go on till June/ July. Candidates need to meet the course-specific eligibility to apply for a course. Below are the steps to get a seat in DPSRU:
STEP 1: DPSRU Application Process 2025

Candidates can apply online or collect the application form from the university campus. Candidates need to fill out the application form on the official website of the university. DPSRU has made clusters for various courses for the convenience of the applicants. For each cluster, a separate application must be made with an application fee of INR 1,000.
STEP 2: Selection
DPSRU selects candidates based on their merit and performance in the accepted exam. The university considers merit in the last qualifying exam for UG courses.
DPSRU UG Admission 2025:
Admission to UG courses such as BPharm, BPT, BSc, and other courses is based on merit of the aspirants in the last qualifying exam. Aspirants should complete a minimum of Class 12 for admission.
DPSRU PG Admission 2025:
The selection for PG courses is based on scores of the candidates in CUET-PG or GPAT scores. The universty offers MPT, MPharm, MSc, etc. at the PG level.
DPSRU MBA Admission 2025:
Candidates must completed their graduation in relevant subjects with at least 55% aggregate and have a valid score in GPAT for some of the specialisations.
DPSRU PhD Admission 2025:
Candidates should have a valid score in GPAT, NET, SLET for admission in PhD programme. The university also conducts DPSRU Entrance Exam for PhD course.
STEP 3: Merit List & Counselling

The university releases a merit list based on the entrance exam score or merit in the last qualifying exam. Aspirants will be called one by one as per the merit list for admission for the courses. If the seat offered is acceptable, the documents will be checked with originals and all relevant submissions. Further, aspirants will need to pay course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.question: How are BPharma placements at Delhi Pharmaceutical Sciences and Research University?
faqs.answer: Delhi Pharmaceutical Sciences and Research University (DPSRU) has a 100% placement rate for all courses. The median package offered to B.Pharm students was INR 4.50 LPA for the 2021-2022 academic year. During the DPSRU placement drive 2022, more than 20 companies visited the campus, and a total of 49 students were placed in top companies such as Dr. Reddy’s, PharmaAce, ZS Associates, among others. Students were offered multiple roles such as Research, Pharmacovigilance, Analytics, Consulting, Ed-Tech, Marketing, Business Consulting, and HRM in addition to the core pharmacist profiles. According to the NIRF report 2023, a total of 106 out of 246 BPharma and MPharma students were placed during placements 2022. reviews.review_heading: Good and affordable medical college.
reviews.review_text: Excellent infrastructure facilities with healthy and sanitary surroundings. There are comfortable classrooms equipped with smart boards with good ventilation. reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied, and the infrastructure is more happening in 1 or 2 years.
reviews.review_text: Very nice infrastructure, well-maintained laboratories, and a fully air-conditioned lecture room. A big library in which all the author books are easily available. The hostel is very neat and clean within walking distance from the main academic building. Mess is also very nice.

reviews.review_heading: Review of BPT course in Delhi Pharmaceutical Science and Research.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are quite spacious, but time-to-time renovation needs to be done. Since the college is under the Delhi government, delay in maintaining the infrastructure is a normal thing. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel. One Mother Dairy shop is there at the entrance on the right side of the college. The hostel is affordable.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure in the hostel is good enough. We get Wi-Fi facility. Library might start soon after renovation. We have a gym with adequate equipment. There is a mother dairy for milk and snacks. Medical officers with MBBS degrees are there for health-related problems.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Delhi Pharmaceutical Sciences and Research University.

Hostel has a Wi-Fi facility with good network speed, but sometimes it lags. However, labs are equipped with necessary apparatus and instruments, but some labs lack air-conditioners. Classrooms are well-maintained with air-conditioners, projectors, desks, and boards.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus placement and better college life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our college is average. This college does not have a large campus. Moreover, there is only one playground in our college for all sports. Our college has good classrooms each classroom has a smartboard. Hostel food of our college is not too good and also has poor hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: The campus area is very small.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our college is top-notch and the college provides everything that is required in pharmacy. Classrooms are good and big. They have Wi-Fi which students can access. Library is good and has all the books related to pharmacy and also has computers which students can avail. There is no canteen in college but a small mother dairy. There are medical facilities as there is OPD in the college and have a sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Good but a bit expensive (according to government college) college.

There is no shortage of books, we can issue books for 30 days. Hence, it helps students who cannot afford pricey books.

reviews.review_heading: Top 16 in NIRF Ranking But No Good Placements.
reviews.review_text: Lecture Theatre (LT) rooms are air-conditioned, and the labs are also pretty good. No availability of Wi-Fi. The library is pretty good compared to other departments of our college. A large number of books are available there, and the library is fully air-conditioned. The availability of internet surfing is also there.

reviews.review_heading: University is absolutely amazing .
reviews.review_text: We have an OPD in our college, where patient flow is good enough to help us learn clinicals. We have a library in our university. Also, we have drinking water and a Wi-Fi connection. Labs are also there, which are very clean and equipped with all kinds of necessary equipment. reviews.review_heading: DPSRU is good for B.Pharma and BPT and also good for placements and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Well-furnished labs in DPSRU and all instruments are available in the lab with the best facilities. The hostel has a good environment, and all rooms are well colored with a table, fan, chair, bed, etc. Mess is available in the hostel and canteen in college, and the sports ground is a little bit small, but outdoor games areas are sufficient.

reviews.review_heading: DPSRU - A short review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The campus is a little small. The lecture theaters are good and have air conditioning. The university labs are also very good, and students can do research whenever they want, as all the lab equipment and chemicals are available.

reviews.review_heading: My honest views on Pharmacy College DIPSAR.

The university has state-of-the-art laboratories equipped with the latest instruments. The university offers hostel facilities for both male and female students, with WiFi and other basic amenities available. The mess food is good, but you may have t...

reviews.review_heading: Overall satisfied because of very good academic values and low fees.
reviews.review_text: The university has a good library with free Wi-Fi access. It also has laboratories for fields like pharmaceutical chemistry, pharmacology, and pharmaceutics. The university has sports facilities and ongoing construction for research facilities. A part of the university infrastructure is still under development in preparation for introducing nursing courses in future years.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Biochemistry - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college is good, having all types of accommodation related to students.

content.Placements: At least 25% of students get placed, and the highest package is 8 LPA along with HRA. Around 75% of students get internships at different institutions in India. Roles offered in our course are assistant professor, biochemistry analyst, industrial work, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The laboratory facilities are good, along with different kinds of instruments for work. The campus is well established with AC, Wi-Fi, electricity, and also has library access till 2 AM at night. Hostel accommodation is good with all facilities like a bed, an almirah, a table, and a chair. Mess is also good.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in English - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it is the best university for the M.A. in English course.

content.Placements: English placements were fairly good. No positions were available in Chemistry, Physics, or any other field. The average starting wage was between 10 LPA and 12 LPA, the minimum was between 2 LPA and 5 LPA, and the maximum was over 15 LPA. Students were losing good agreement after passing the third quarter M.A. with a score of over 92%. Higher-level positions included teacher, secretary, and so forth.
content.Infrastructure: Students could use the Wi-Fi offered on campus. The lab workers were actively involved in maintaining labs. Air conditioning and frequent maintenance were features of classrooms. It was a big library with lots of books. The hostel's cuisine was really clean and hygienic. It was easy to go to the hospital. Playing games and sports was strongly recommended.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Geology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: My days at Central University of Punjab.

content.Placements: Placements are something that is lacking in the CUP. There are only few departments that are offering placements and all others don't have any placements. Most of the private companies are associated with the placement cell of CUP and still it needs improvement. There are no placements for the department of Geology.
content.Infrastructure: Course is good and the facility is also good. The labs are well maintained and Wi-Fi is somehow very bad. Library is open till 2:00 AM, and has a lot of security throughout your way back to the hostel. Mess and canteen are good and food is also good. It has a medical center with an ambulance facility. There are snakes during the summer and its a treat.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Geology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I'm not that much satisfied with my university because the academics are quite good.

content.Placements: Very average on placement, the packages are offered around 20,000 - 40,000 INR. Mainly mines and quarries are recruiting. 60-70% of students are getting internships, and the syllabus is very good for the students who want to get a good job, you have to consider this.
content.Infrastructure: There is a very good facility in the hostel, especially the washrooms, which are very clean and well-maintained, so it’s not a problem for us. The reading room is there for us, and it’s very nice and quiet. The hostel has a very good environment for studying, and that will definitely help us.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Mathematics - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the best University for an M.Sc. in Mathematics Course.

content.Placements: Almost 70% of the students got placed in the college. Half of the students chose to pursue their Masters. The college offered a lot of work. Several companies like Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Google, and some other IT companies visited the university for recruitment. The average salary was about Rs. 15 LPA. 66% of students get employment opportunities. The top roles offered are Statistician, Actuary, and more.

Some of the departments do not have Wi-Fi, and the laboratories are good enough to keep up with both practical and theoretical information. There are many games and sports available, such as judo, wrestling, table tennis, chess, badminton, volleyball, basketball, soccer, cricket, kabaddi, cross country, and cycling.

paragraphs: CUPB offers postgraduate courses in a full-time mode in streams such as Arts, Management, Commerce, Science, Law and many more. For all PG programmes, candidates need to clearCUCETwhich is followed by a counselling process.CUPB admission to all the programmes is solely done on the basis of merit obtained inthe Central Universities Common Entrance Test(CUET), followed by counselling. The application process is only online, and no candidature is considered without a valid score in the entrance examination. Candidates need to register and check the CUET website for regular updates.At the time of admission, all candidates need to submit a medical fitness certificate to certify that they are fit to pursue higher studies.

Central University of Punjab (CUPB)is a full-time postgraduate university that provides postgraduate courses in various streams likeArts, Management, Commerce and Scienceand many more. All PG programmes are entrance based throughCUETand then a counselling process. Application is entirelyonline,and only applicants with a valid CUET score will be considered. Students should also provide amedical fitness certificateat the time of admission to ensure they qualify to undertake higher studies.

Step 1: CUPB Application Process 2025Applications should be made online via theCUET site. They are required to complete the application form and attach the documents required as well as pay the application fee. TheCUET portalprovides regular updates and notifications about the entrance exam, which a candidate should check regularly.

Step 2: Entrance Exam (CUET)All PG programmes at CUPB are admitted based on theCentral Universities Common Entrance Test (CUET). This exam is required of all applicants in order to be eligible to take subsequent rounds of admission.

Step 3: Counselling and the Document CheckThose shortlisted are invited tocounsellingaccording to their CUET scores. Students during counselling need to submit all original documents so that they can be verified, such as themedical fitness certificate. After successful verification and payment of the admission fee, the final seat allotment is done.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, having all types of accommodation related to students.
reviews.review_text: The laboratory facilities are good, along with different kinds of instruments for work. The campus is well established with AC, Wi-Fi, electricity, and also has library access till 2 AM at night. Hostel accommodation is good with all facilities like a bed, an almirah, a table, and a chair. Mess is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best university for the M.A. in English course.
reviews.review_text: Students could use the Wi-Fi offered on campus. The lab workers were actively involved in maintaining labs. Air conditioning and frequent maintenance were features of classrooms. It was a big library with lots of books. The hostel's cuisine was really clean and hygienic. It was easy to go to the hospital. Playing games and sports was strongly recommended.

reviews.review_heading: My days at Central University of Punjab.
reviews.review_text: Course is good and the facility is also good. The labs are well maintained and Wi-Fi is somehow very bad. Library is open till 2:00 AM, and has a lot of security throughout your way back to the hostel. Mess and canteen are good and food is also good. It has a medical center with an ambulance facility. There are snakes during the summer and its a treat.

reviews.review_heading: I'm not that much satisfied with my university because the academics are quite good.
reviews.review_text: There is a very good facility in the hostel, especially the washrooms, which are very clean and well-maintained, so it’s not a problem for us. The reading room is there for us, and it’s very nice and quiet. The hostel has a very good environment for studying, and that will definitely help us.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best University for an M.Sc. in Mathematics Course.
reviews.review_text: The resources are the best, with well-spaced classrooms. The library is also good. Some of the departments do not have Wi-Fi, and the laboratories are good enough to keep up with both practical and theoretical information. There are many games and sports available, such as judo, wrestling, table tennis, chess, badminton, volleyball, basketball, soccer, cricket, kabaddi, cross country, and cycling.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best University for M.Sc. In Chemistry Course.
reviews.review_text: The university has a good infrastructure for courses. The classrooms are equipped with mixed technology, and there are large computer labs with software licenses. The two-story library has some good books but is lacking in textbooks. The hostel is well located inside the campus, but only the two top students in each batch can stay there. The food is good, but the menu is pretty much the same every week.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best University for M.A. in English Course.
reviews.review_text: The university provides a good amount of practical expertise. Classrooms are outfitted with modern amenities to help you generate new ideas and express yourself. There is complete freedom to express your opinions and ideas. The library has sophisticated facilities. The staff is extremely helpful and caring.

reviews.review_heading: Overall the best university for M.Sc. in geography course.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is located distant from the city, especially in Punjab. Every campus has Wi-Fi. The infrastructure of the college is very interesting. The hostel on campus is open to both boys and girls. These include classrooms, libraries, and hallways. The hotel amenities are excellent, however, the food served to students is super. Students can also access medical and sports amenities here.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best University for M.A. in History Course.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college was adequate for the history course. The college provided adequate laboratory facilities for students to gain practical experience. The pupils were given access to all required amenities, including a canteen, Wi-Fi, library, hostel, sports, and medical care. All of these facilities were of high quality at CU Punjab.

reviews.review_heading: It's a developing college, has good infrastructure, but there are not many fests.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure sector are very well covered in the Central University of Punjab. The campus and hostels have good Wi-Fi coverage. The classes and labs have all the required technology available, including items like 3D printers. The food in the mess is fine.

reviews.review_heading: It is a new developing college, as many buildings are under construction.
reviews.review_text: There are sufficient labs and classrooms where classes are conducted using the best technologies. Moreover, every classroom and lab has projectors, smart boards, and whiteboards for better role-play. The quality of food in the mess is average, but the canteen outside the academic block, named Suraj Bhaiya’s canteen, has the best snacks in the area. There are many cafeterias outside the campus and 2-3 stalls of Amul, Verka, and Nescafe.

reviews.review_heading: CUPB has very good infrastructure and well-educated faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good infrastructure. There are well-furnished libraries with a great collection of books in a huge quantity. Labs are well-designed for students and Ph.D. scholars. Classrooms are in digital mode. They are fully air-conditioned. Wi-Fi is good in hostels as well as in academic areas. CCTV cameras are available in the campus area.

reviews.review_heading: CUPB is excellent and perfect.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is perfect. We have Wi-Fi available in every building. We have labs for subjects like Chemistry and other science disciplines. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned. Library is stocked with various books by different authors. Hostel is also very good. The quality of food is average. We have canteen and medical facilities, with doctor available 24/7. There is a playground where we play football.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with academics.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and hostel are improving. This university is a new university, just started in 2009, so the infrastructure is still improving. A new library and classrooms are there, and the hostel facilities and mess are good enough. The cleanliness and all are really good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, placements not good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and the hostel facilities are very average. The rooms are shared between four people of different departments. The washroom facilities are also decent; workers clean them at least once every day. Food in the mess is like your regular home-cooked food, but the canteens are not available here near the hostel. You have to walk a lot to get basic groceries also.

These reviews and ratings have been given by students. Shiksha does not endorse the same. Out of 46 published reviews , 41 reviews are verified.

faqs.question: Is direct admission possible in Banasthali University?
faqs.answer: Bananasthali Vidyapith course admissions to all courses is both merit and entrance-based. The university offers admission to various UG and PG courses. The university conductes Banasthali University Aptitude Test for admission to selective courses such as BTech, MBA, BSc Nursing, LLM, etc. There is no way to get direct admission to these courses. Admissions are solely based on entrance exam. However for courses such as BA, BSc, BCom, MA, MSc, etc.,. There is no requirement to qualify for any entrance exam. Candidates are only required to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria and fill an online application form. Based on the past academic records of the applicants, the university will select the right candidates.

faqs.question: What are the courses that Banasthali Vidyapith offers?
faqs.answer: The university offers 15+ undergraduate courses in the disciplines of Mathematics, Science, Management, Commerce, Arts, Engineering, Aviation, Education, Design, Law, and Journalism. It also offers 60+ masters and 25+ PhD courses in the disciplines of Humanities, Social Sciences, Law, Education, Commerce and Management. The popular courses of Banasthali Vidyapith are BTech and MBA. These courses are offered across various specialisations. Admission to most of the courses at Banashtali Vidyapith is entrance-based. Whereas, for other courses, candidates are selected based on their previous merit scores.

faqs.question: What is the last date for Banasthali Vidyapith admission form?
faqs.answer: Banasthali Vidyapith admissions are currently open. The university usually releases the admission form in April. Since admission to some of the courses is entrance-based, the university also releases the dates for the aptitude test. The university conducts Banasthali University Aptitude Test in June for different courses.

faqs.question: Can I apply offline for B.A LL.B admissions at Banasthali Vidyapith?
faqs.answer: Yes, Banasthali Vidyapith BA LLB application can be submitted in offline mode. To apply offline, students are required to send a DD/IPO for INR 1,000 in favour of 'Banasthali Vidyapith' payable at Banasthali/Jaipur, in order to obtain a prospectus and application form. It is to be sent to-Secretary-Banasthali Vidyapith, P.O. Banasthali Vidyapith -304022, Rajasthan, INDIA.

Through the years, the QS World University Rankings for Banasthali Vidyapith indicate the institute's strong performance in important areas such as the Quality of Education, Conducting Impactful Research, the Expertise of Faculty members, and Overall Institutional Management. These good rankings not only prove the institute's good reputation but also highlight its excellence across diverse domains, evaluated against the standards established by the QS World University Rankings. It has been seen that in the 'Asia' category, the institute's ranks have shown a decreasing trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2026, Banasthali Vidyapith fell 80 ranks to #741 rank in the 'Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
It has been seen that within the category of 'Southern Asia', the institute's ranking has fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2026, Banasthali Vidyapith fell 22 ranks to #224 rank in the 'Southern Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings.

review_summary.college_name: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Affordable education with good infrastructure and below-average placement support.

content.Placements: I belonged to the B.Com (Hons) batch at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Lucknow. Placement opportunities are average. The highest package offered is around 4 LPA-5 LPA, the lowest package is about 1.8 LPA-2 LPA, and the average package stood at approximately 2.5 LPA-3 LPA. Some of the top recruiting companies that visited the campus included TCS, Infosys (support roles), HDFC Bank, etc. About 40-50 percent of students managed to get internships mostly in banks. Many students also secured internships on their own through online platforms. The top roles offered are Accounts Executive, Junior Accountant, etc.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Journalism and Mass Communication - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: College was pretty fine, value for money, but average compared to good media colleges.

content.Placements: Hardly 10% of students got placed. The highest package was 3.6 LPA, and the lowest was 2.2 LPA. Only 5 out of 50 students got placement, that too on the professor's personal favors and relations. So, you have to prepare and place yourself by searching for a decent job on your own, otherwise, it is tough here.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi and labs were available, but we rarely had lab visits. The hostels were nice with average food. There were many hostels, only students from outside Uttar Pradesh got a hostel here, so be prepared for hostel and mess expenses if you are from Uttar Pradesh itself.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Best university for M.Sc. in physics course.

content.Placements: Currently, the placements happening for us. In my senior batch, 90% of them were placed. Many companies come in looking for jobs, but most companies come in looking for employment and financial information. We had a great choice of dual specialisation, which made it easier for us to clarify what to do for the best placements. The roles offered were aeronautical engineer, laboratory technician, etc. Internships were offered.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel was nice and completely furnished with Wi-Fi and beds. The cuisine at the hostel was superb. The infrastructure of our lab was excellent. Our classrooms were tidy. Our college had digital classrooms. Hospital and eateries were beneficial. Our college promoted student participation in sports and games.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is a nice place with 24/7 library access.

content.Placements: There are 100 students in my course. The highest package is 5 lacs, and the lowest is 3 lacs. Others included several NGOs, schools, and coaching centers. The teaching role involved an internship in a government school. All students completed their internships.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. The department had a library and a smart classroom, which was helpful for micro-teaching and simulated teaching. Most girls stayed in the hostel, while about 70% of the boys had to stay outside the campus. The food in the hostel was good.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Life Sciences - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Professors are very helpful in nature. It is a good university.

content.Placements: The batch is very good, there are 32 students in my class. The college faculty members do not allow us to do internships. In the last semester, there was a training program held by the university. The training programme is held by ICAR in Nainital. But they take money for this, and we go on to study tour in Uttarakhand.
content.Infrastructure: There is a very poor Wi-Fi connection, and the library is good. Classrooms do not have AC. In the hostel, the mess food is a disaster. The canteen is also not so good. Medical facilities are very fast but not so good. Sports and games are also available in this college. The central library is very good with full AC.

paragraphs: The University has not released the 2025 placement report yet. However, the NIRF report 2025 is out on the official website. According to the report, 151 UG 3-year students, 36 PG 1-year and 1,302 PG 2-year students were placed during BBAU placements 2022. The median package offered to UG 3-year courses during Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University placements 2024 stood at INR 11.85 LPA. For PG 1-year and PG 2-year, the median package offered was INR 6.92 LPA and INR 9.52 LPA, respectively.

One can observe that within the category of 'University', the institute's ranking has fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, BBAU Lucknow fell 4 ranks to #37 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking.

reviews.review_heading: Affordable education with good infrastructure and below-average placement support.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University is quite good and well spread across a large green campus. Classrooms for B.Com (Hons) are spacious and well-ventilated. The university has a central library with a good collection of commerce, management, and reference books along with reading halls. Wi-Fi facility is available on campus. Hostel facilities are decent with separate hostels for boys and girls. Rooms are clean and basic amenities like water and electricity are provided. T...

reviews.review_heading: College was pretty fine, value for money, but average compared to good media colleges.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and labs were available, but we rarely had lab visits. The hostels were nice with average food. There were many hostels, only students from outside Uttar Pradesh got a hostel here, so be prepared for hostel and mess expenses if you are from Uttar Pradesh itself.

reviews.review_heading: Best university for M.Sc. in physics course.
reviews.review_text: Hostel was nice and completely furnished with Wi-Fi and beds. The cuisine at the hostel was superb. The infrastructure of our lab was excellent. Our classrooms were tidy. Our college had digital classrooms. Hospital and eateries were beneficial. Our college promoted student participation in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: It is a nice place with 24/7 library access.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The department had a library and a smart classroom, which was helpful for micro-teaching and simulated teaching. Most girls stayed in the hostel, while about 70% of the boys had to stay outside the campus. The food in the hostel was good.

reviews.review_heading: Professors are very helpful in nature. It is a good university.
reviews.review_text: There is a very poor Wi-Fi connection, and the library is good. Classrooms do not have AC. In the hostel, the mess food is a disaster. The canteen is also not so good. Medical facilities are very fast but not so good. Sports and games are also available in this college. The central library is very good with full AC.

reviews.review_heading: Good lush green campus and well-equipped library.
reviews.review_text: We have fully ventilated and Wi-Fi enabled classroom, computer labs, and library with all the relevant books for study. As for the hostels, they are very good in condition. The food in canteen is average. We also have a medical facility available for us. We have playground with all types of sports and one sports center for indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great place for education. It has a good infrastructure, but there is a lack of placements.
reviews.review_text: The campus has a good infrastructure with pace and calmness. Every department has a Wi-Fi facility with good speed. All classrooms are also well-maintained and specially structured to prevent suffocation problems. It has good ventilation, a great library, etc.

reviews.review_heading: A college with attractive campus and helpful faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very excellent. Wi-Fi is also very good, and classrooms are fully AC. The library is also fully AC and Wi-Fi is available 24*7. Hostels are also very good, according to price. The mess and canteen food are far better than those at other colleges. There is a health centre in the university for students. Sports events are also organised at the university.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Central University, Lucknow.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are nice and clean, but the only demerit is that most people don't get a hostel as there is not a sufficient number of hostels. The rooms are okay, but not very good. Overall, the hostel facilities and mess are good, and you can expect a hostel if you are not close to the college.

reviews.review_heading: I hope for betterment soon.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are still lacking because this course is very new at the university. Hostels are pretty good, and the quality of food is also nice. There are many opportunities for a person if he or she is into sports. There are many clubs, and the library is one of the best in this college.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with 80% placements in 2024. It has good staff members and professors.
reviews.review_text: We will get accommodation facility in form of hostels which is generally 2-3 seaters. Water, Wi-Fi, and electricity facilities are available for free. There is a fee of around Rs. 2,600 per semester for the hostel. Few hostels have a gym and common room with AC to study. Guest rooms for parents are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Some departments have good management but some do not. The college life is fun here.
reviews.review_text: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University (BBAU) in Lucknow has areas that could be improved. The positive aspects are it is beautiful and green. Wi-Fi is available at departments and hostels. Some Classrooms are equipped with smart boards in some departments.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is good but placement and college life are not that good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of hostel is good. Wi-Fi is available all the time. Mostly books are available in library of our branch which are easily issued by students. Classroom conditions are good. Hostel food is also good and all sub-services are available in hostels. Lab equipment are not available in labs. Infrastructure is also not that good, it is below average.

reviews.review_heading: Disappointed because of faculty and peer pressure of exams but satisfied with infrastructure 2025.
reviews.review_text: There is no such place which can be described as a lab. There is a dummy lab which contains a few computer systems, mainly used by professors, and most of them are faculty, so can't be used. The processors of computer systems can be compared with turtles. Hostels are fine enough to stay with the best facilities like geysers, water coolers, etc.

reviews.review_heading: A review about BBAU University from the Geology department.
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi: All the departments and buildings of the campus are installed with free Wi-Fi networks that every student can access using their unique login code and password.

Classrooms: Classrooms are well furnished, but they are not air-conditioned. You may find it difficult during the summers as the temperature within the classrooms also reaches high.
