individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Excellent academic and corporate grooming.

content.Placements: At JD Birla Institute, everyone is eligible for a placement, but most of the students pursue an MBA, or they join family businesses, bringing the percentage down around 15-60 percent. The highest package is 9 LPA and the average is 5 LPA-6 LPA. The top recruiting companies include EY, Deloitte, HSBC Bank, and Amazon. In my batch, 100 percent of students got internships at top companies, such as TCS and Exide Industries. Top roles offered are business analyst, financial manager, account manager, HR, marketing, and sales executive.
content.Infrastructure: It is well regarded for maintaining a corporate-like environment, which is suitable for management studies. Classrooms are air-conditioned with smart boards. A fully automated library with quite a variety of books. Fully equipped computer lab with the latest software and Wi-Fi on campus. There are no official hostels, most students stay in nearby paying guests. The college has a very hygienic canteen. The college has an in-house infirmary. Sports facilities include a badminton court and a recreational area, including table tennis, football, and carrom board. While the college is very compact in terms of area.

reviews.review_heading: Review of J.D Birla Institute (JDBI).
reviews.review_text: We have good classrooms, a canteen, labs, a library, and even the college is undergoing renovation, providing us with greater facilities and a more comfortable infrastructure. We have AC classrooms and comfortable seating arrangements. The canteen food is good, and the library has a vast range of books with borrowing facilities.

reviews.review_heading: College with the best return on investment.
reviews.review_text: Being a state university, the institute is heavily underfunded. As a result, the infrastructure is not upto the mark in comparison to IITs and NITs. Though a good amount of research does take place. Hostel specifically is not of great quality, but that is justified by its ultra-cheap rent of Rs 30 per month.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a great college with the best return on investment, one can get with good placements.
reviews.review_text: Labs are well-maintained and have the necessary facilities for the course. From 2025 onwards, a new syllabus is being introduced which removes irrelevant courses in the first year that have been a part of the course for many years, replacing them with necessary subjects.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college. It is the best state university in India.
reviews.review_text: The department coordinated well with the students. There is Wi-Fi available. Library is one of the biggest in the whole West Bengal. The campus is very big, and has 6 canteens where food of every range is available.

reviews.review_heading: The college has very good infrastructure and resources.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of our department are very good. The whole department and campus have free Wi-Fi. Classrooms, library, and computer labs are also very modern. Hostel facilities are very good, with rooms for study, food services, and a canteen available. Every sports instrument is available, with a good playground.

reviews.review_heading: Jadavpur University food technology course summary and college life idea.
reviews.review_text: Free Wi-Fi is available on the whole campus. There are a total of 9 canteens, and each hostel has its own separate cooking area. Table tennis, cricket, and football are the most popular sports. The sports culture and fests are the most lovable part of Jadavpur University.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with good faculty, placements, and affordable education.
reviews.review_text: The college is good. Hostels are clean. The menu is good and cheap. It has clean labs, and toilets are provided. Medical facilities are also provided. The library is very big and good. Many books are present in the library.

reviews.review_heading: Awesome placements, top-notch faculty, and the college with the highest ROI.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are non-AC, and college infrastructure is decent. Labs are also decent; only the computer lab has AC. Wi-Fi is available throughout the whole campus. A large central library and a departmental library are available. Hostel is so-so, also about mess food. I live outside campus in a PG. I would say the hostel should not be preferred. There is a large playground on the campus, and also an ATMA SBI bank.

reviews.review_heading: Jadavpur University has got tier-1 rank by NAAC.

reviews.review_heading: An outstanding course for higher studies.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing return on investment and value for money. Amazing campus life and very good placements.

paragraphs: ISF College of Pharmacy offers placement for all undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. In 2018, the college had placed a total of 114 students during campus placement.

In 2014-18 batch, a total of 116 students were admitted to UG (4 years) programmes, out of which 88 students got placed during campus placements. Apart from this, 19 students opted for higher studies. The placement trends of the previous years for UG (4 years) programmes are given in the graph shown below:

A total of 31 students got admitted to PG (2 years) programmes in 2016-18 batch, out of which 26 students got recruited during campus placement and five students have opted for higher studies. Given below are the placement trends of the previous years for PG (2 years) programmes.

Maharishi Markandeshwar University applications are closed now for admission to UG & PG courses. It offers more than 150 courses across several streams.The courses are designed to be delivered in full-time mode. Step 2: Selection: The selectionprocess may vary from course to course at MMDU Ambala. Candidates must meet the required entrance examination score. For several courses, such as BA, MA, BCom, BBA, etc., passing the Class 12 exam alone becomes a qualifying criterion.

Step 3: Counselling:Maharishi Markandeshwar University will conduct counselling round for students who have valid scores in the qualifying examination and have been shortlisted in the merit list; they will be called out for the counselling session.
Step 4: Payment of fee:At the time of counselling process, candidates will have to pay the fee for their desired course.

The university also accepts other national-level entrance exams such as GATE, JEE Main, etc. Once the candidates have appeared for CUET-UG and CUET-PG, the university opens counselling registration on the CURAJ Samarth Portal. Aspirants are required to login with their CUET no. and password and fill out the registration form.
STEP 3: Counselling and Admission Confirmation

Candidates seeking admission via entrance exams other than CUET are required to pay the course fee to confirm their seat in the university after selection. CUET applicants are called counselling and seat allotment. As per the preference filled by them and their CUET rank, they are offered seat in various round. faqs.answer: Central University of Rajasthan admissions open withCUET-UGandCUET-PGregistrations. The application process for CUET-UG begin in February and ends by March. faqs.question: Is Central University of Rajasthan under CUET?
faqs.answer: Yes, Central University of Rajasthan is one of the participating universities of CUET. The university offers admission to Integrated BSc-MSc throughCUET-UGscore. faqs.answer: Candidates applying viaCUET-UGandCUET-PGhave to fill out the application form for the respective exam. faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

reviews.review_heading: University is very nice, but not as good.
reviews.review_text: The environmental sciences Depth at CURAJ has Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a central library. Hostels are decent with Wi-Fi, clean rooms, and mess food is average but hygienic, a medical center is available, and good sports facilities for games and fitness.

reviews.review_heading: College is really good, and if you want to pursue Biotechnology, then you should take this one.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, labs are great, classrooms are well structured, and the library facilities are nice. Hostel facility is good, mess facility is below average, canteen facility is good. Medical facilities are not much good. Sports and games are well, courts and grounds are available in this university.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and qualified faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is really amazing in departments, but Wi-Fi is rarely available in department. Classrooms are fine with projector fixed and enough storage. Library is also good. Hostels are okay, and food quality depends on tenders. Sports ground is good, and students are also always excited. Sports activities happen every other day.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied, really.
reviews.review_text: Proper Wi-Fi is provided by the university, classrooms are good, and there is a central library, a reading room, and also a reading room in the department where students can read in their free time after class. Well, mess with pure vegetarian food, well, the quality of food provided.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied because of the amazing faculty, and the infrastructure and facilities are very good.

Classrooms are very huge with installed AC and speaker. Wi-Fi connectivity is great. Living in the hostel is better, but the food is average; also no variety of food is available in the canteen. Medical facilities are great, an ambulance is also available, and all types of sports and games are available: courts and grounds.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of teachers and department facilities are good, living in hostel is also better .

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Amazing campus, good placements, good infrastructure and facilities.

review_content.Placements: 75% of students were placed in Civil this year. The highest package was around 16 LPA, the median package was around 8 LPA, and the lowest package was around 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies include IOCL, Deloitte, Accenture, Hindalco, TATA, etc. Top roles include structural engineer, project manager, and urban planner.
review_content.Infrastructure: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled (around 150 Mbps if you get a strong signal). The hostel Wi-Fi works well most of the time, but sometimes it goes down. The food varies hostel-wise. It is better than other colleges (you won't find insects and all in your food daily).

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Good college, hostel facility avg, placements are avg, and lush green campus.

review_content.Placements: The highest package last year, 2024, was 1.45 crores, and the average package was almost 11.5 LPA. Almost every company has different roles offered here at the college. The placements record of this year has not come out as per true strength, but it is expected that the placements are more or less the same as the previous year.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostels are good, but the water in the bathrooms is hard. The hair feels oily after a bath, and despite having a water purifying setup at Mesra, the drinking water is not up to that standard. The Wi-Fi here is not reliable. Sometimes it gets cut due to unnecessary reasons, and gaming on hostel Wi-Fi is restricted. You can't play any game here unless you find a solution. The food quality is decent.

faqs.answer: The technology institute admits candidates to BTech courses based on merit in the JEE Main exam. There is no other provision for admission. Candidates shortlisted based on exam scores must also participate in the JoSAA counselling round for seat allotment. In case the seats are left vacant after JoSAA counselling, then those are filled through CSAB counselling. This is the only criteria for admission. Candidates can contact the BIT Mesra admission office to check for direct admissions.
faqs.question: Q: Can I apply for BTech at BIT Mesra without JEE Main score?

faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure is well maintained, and the placements are good, with the average being 11–12 LPA

content.Placements: In my course at BIT Mesra, about 65–70 percent students get placed consistently, but from the past few years it has dropped slightly. The highest package is 19 LPA and the lowest is 3 LPA, and an average of 7.5–8 LPA is common. There are many top companies like Google, Microsoft, and a lot of core companies which visit the campus consistently. 60 percent of students get internships in core companies and tech companies. Roles include site engineer, design engineer, quantity surveyor, trainee engineer, and roles in structural, geotechnical, transportation, and environmental engineering.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Civil maatt lo CSE, mech, ECE, EEE are good options.

content.Placements: The students were placed, but the LPA was not worth it. We have a 4 LPA average in our branch, but according to the price, it is not worth it at all. On top of that, you have to pay such a hefty amount. Go for this branch only if you are interested in government exams or if you want a good NIRF ranking college.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. The campus is big and full of greenery, and it has good vibes in terms of nature. The buildings are also good, but the hostels and their Wi-Fi are not good, as Wi-Fi is down most of the time, due to which I recommend that you take a backup plan for Wi-Fi for yourself.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Amazing campus, good placements, good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: 75% of students were placed in Civil this year. The highest package was around 16 LPA, the median package was around 8 LPA, and the lowest package was around 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies include IOCL, Deloitte, Accenture, Hindalco, TATA, etc. Top roles include structural engineer, project manager, and urban planner.
content.Infrastructure: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled (around 150 Mbps if you get a strong signal). The hostel Wi-Fi works well most of the time, but sometimes it goes down. The food varies hostel-wise. It is better than other colleges (you won't find insects and all in your food daily).

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good college, hostel facility avg, placements are avg, and lush green campus.

content.Placements: The highest package last year, 2024, was 1.45 crores, and the average package was almost 11.5 LPA. Almost every company has different roles offered here at the college. The placements record of this year has not come out as per true strength, but it is expected that the placements are more or less the same as the previous year.
content.Infrastructure: The hostels are good, but the water in the bathrooms is hard. The hair feels oily after a bath, and despite having a water purifying setup at Mesra, the drinking water is not up to that standard. The Wi-Fi here is not reliable. Sometimes it gets cut due to unnecessary reasons, and gaming on hostel Wi-Fi is restricted. You can't play any game here unless you find a solution. The food quality is decent.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Used to be good, but now it's doomed.

content.Placements: Nearly 60-80 percent of my courses were placed last year. The highest is 50 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average is around 15 LPA. Oracle, Infosys, Texas Instruments, Intel, Microsoft, Google, Goldman Sachs, Atlassian, etc. The roles offered are SDE, hardware engineer, network engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi is good, but is restricted to a limited number of sites. Labs aren't maintained regularly, and the classrooms are enough to accommodate, but not all the teachers are well-equipped to tech. The library is good, but the environment there isn't good. The hostel is just bad. The food is bad. The rooms that are meant to be for one person are currently given to two students.

hostel_campus.college_name: BIT Mesra Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra is completely residential with eleven hostels for boys and three separate ones for girls. All student lodging houses are spacious and beautifully laid out amidst a lot greenery. Each male-student is provided with well-furnished single-accommodation while girls share their accommodation in spacious and adequately furnished rooms. Individual rooms are constructed in a row with a wide veranda for common use running along the length of passage. Common facilities at the hostel include dining halls and common rooms with provision for several indoor games. The reading room in each hostel subscribes to a large number of magazines, periodicals and newspapers. The entertainment hall in each hostel has a color television set. Each hostel has an independent mess, completely run and managed by the students themselves. The hostels are a hub of leisure activities. Students are encouraged to pursue a wide range of extra curricular activities and hobbies in their free time and events both entertaining and competitive are arranged quite frequently. Inter-hostel tournaments of indoor and outdoor games, quizzes, competitions and adventure trips are very popular at BIT Mesra. The 'Hostel Night' organized by resident students is a memorable yearly event where students interact with the faculty members amidst cultural programmes and a lot of fun in a shared mood of festivity.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is well maintained, and the placements are good, with the average being 11–12 LPA
reviews.review_text: Many equipment in the labs are damaged but still being used. The Wi-Fi connection is very good, giving a high-speed network of up to 100 Mbps. The library is quite disappointing as books are in bad condition and there are not enough facilities, and there is no AC in the library.

reviews.review_heading: Civil maatt lo CSE, mech, ECE, EEE are good options.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. The campus is big and full of greenery, and it has good vibes in terms of nature. The buildings are also good, but the hostels and their Wi-Fi are not good, as Wi-Fi is down most of the time, due to which I recommend that you take a backup plan for Wi-Fi for yourself.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing campus, good placements, good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled (around 150 Mbps if you get a strong signal). The hostel Wi-Fi works well most of the time, but sometimes it goes down. The food varies hostel-wise. It is better than other colleges (you won't find insects and all in your food daily).

reviews.review_heading: Good college, hostel facility avg, placements are avg, and lush green campus.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are good, but the water in the bathrooms is hard. The hair feels oily after a bath, and despite having a water purifying setup at Mesra, the drinking water is not up to that standard. The Wi-Fi here is not reliable. Sometimes it gets cut due to unnecessary reasons, and gaming on hostel Wi-Fi is restricted. You can't play any game here unless you find a solution. The food quality is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Used to be good, but now it's doomed.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi is good, but is restricted to a limited number of sites. Labs aren't maintained regularly, and the classrooms are enough to accommodate, but not all the teachers are well-equipped to tech. The library is good, but the environment there isn't good. The hostel is just bad. The food is bad. The rooms that are meant to be for one person are currently given to two students.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, but only recommend for branches like CSE and AIML.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, but there are some restrictions, like the game website is blocked, and the mess food is average, like in a week they give 4-5 good meals. The hostel room is quite small, not for 2 people. The classroom is good with proper projectors. Free medical facilities are also available sports facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good.
reviews.review_text: There is a very good Wi-Fi connection inside the campus, like in the hostel, classrooms, and labs. The classrooms are very clean, with AC, projectors, and well-ventilated. The labs are also good. We have a lab for every course. The hostels are neat and clean. Every day, the hostels are cleaned and the washrooms also, but the hostel rooms are to be cleaned by the students after that particular room.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with above average placement for both circuit and non-circuit branches.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi inside the campus is good, high-speed, but it fluctuates a lot, sometimes it gives 150 mbps and other times it goes down to kbps, so it's unpredictable. Labs have all the required equipment available, some equipment does need changes, and it is either broken or old, but overall, it's good.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members in CSE are good, but for ECE, they are the worst. Good coding culture in college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are very small. In the first year, hostel rooms are still big, but from the second year, their size is very small. In a room, 2 students are present, which is something that I don't like about this college. There are also some three-sharing rooms in the hostel, and they are pretty good, but only a few students get them. Wi-Fi is average, like those students whose rooms are in the corners of the hostel didn't get much access to Wi-Fi. Classrooms are 10/10, like they are very good. La...

reviews.review_heading: A very good college but you have to spend 10 lakhs in 2 years.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, it is having large number of books. Labs are spacious and have all the apparatus used in industry. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. Boys hostel is 4 to 5 km away from the college. Mess food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied and value for money.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided are as follows: 5G Wi-Fi available 24/7, classroom projectors with centralized air conditioning, a very large library with all types of books available, hostel mess food above average, and night canteen available in each hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I will recommend Birla Institute of Technology Mesra.
reviews.review_text: The food menu is decided by the student body living in that. Home-like food in some hostels, like H5, is great. Any problem, we have Dean sir, for student affairs. If anyone is behaving rudely, you can talk to sir, and you do not need any other proof.

reviews.review_heading: Placement varies every year. Infrastructure and environment are good. Faculty depends on the course.
reviews.review_text: Management is questionable but the infrastructure is quite good. Hostel rooms are kind of small for two students but you will get used to them in no time. The Wi-Fi is available all around the campus so its a plus point. Sports facilities are decent. Dispensary provide free medicine.

reviews.review_heading: I am neither dissatisfied nor satisfied, but happy with what I got.
reviews.review_text: The campus is big, but it has great potential to be one of the greatest campuses in India. Many places on the campus are only trees, and all that's good because the AQI is good on the campus. Still, there are places where much infrastructure can be built.

reviews.review_heading: It is good for circuit courses in B.Tech and for mechanical engineering only.
reviews.review_text: The library, playgrounds, and classrooms are good with AC and smartboards. Hostels aren't that good, with quite small rooms, but we would adjust. Food in the mess is okay, and Wi-Fi is decent. Labs are all well-equipped, and we won't face any problem regarding that. Apart from that, the campus is very beautiful and pollution-free with a lot of trees.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the college.

content.Placements: The placements are okay. But it all depends on us to crack the interview. And not complete placement is provided. The labs are not that good. I think some more high instruments, equipment, and chemicals should be added. Overall, Andhra University provides a comprehensive and supportive environment for students to pursue their academic and extracurricular interests.
content.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi. We have a big library, and the food in the canteen is excellent. There is a hospital where we can go. The hostels are good, and okay mess food As I was a day scholar, I got to know it by my friends. Andhra University encourages students to participate in sports and games, promoting physical fitness and teamwork.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the faculty and facilities.

content.Placements: In my college, there is not much availability for placements for students. The students belonging to both MPC and Bi. PC groups are eligible to join the B. Pharmacy course, which is a 4-year course. Students with above-average marks are eligible for this course. There are few companies that offer jobs. If any company recruits, the package may be INR 2.8 LPA for freshers. The top recruiting companies are Hetero, Pfizer, Biophore, Lee Pharma, Aurobindo, Biopharma, etc. The college did not provide any internships, but if we have any interest in doing one, the college gives permission to do one.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with this college but not with internships and placements.

content.Placements: Maximum of 75% of students get placed in our course. The salary package offered is average. Top recruiting companies are Lee Pharma, Pulses, etc. Internships are not provided but our college gives permission for students to do internships in any company.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are average. Wi-Fi is available but it doesn't work well. Labs are provided but there is no proper equipment. Classrooms are neat and clean. Library is provided to study books. The quality of infrastructure is average.

individual_reviews.course: Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Our university is excellent.

content.Placements: Almost 70% of students are placed based on their skills and performance. The salary package purely depends on the companies where students are placed. The average salary package offered is 4 LPA. Clinical pharmacist is the top role offered in our course.
content.Infrastructure: In this college, the infrastructure of the lab is very good. The hostel is nearby for girls and it is very good for girls. The medical dispensary is provided.
content.Faculty: This course is a 6-year graduation course that consists of a 1-year internship. Semester exams are conducted yearly. Teachers explain very well and the remaining 70% of hard work depends on students' effort. Semester exams are easy if students read well from the very beginning and it is easy to get a good percentage.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall review for AU college of pharmaceutical sciences.

content.Placements: After the final year of the 1st semester, there are opportunities for placements. There are also many placement opportunities here. Many popular and best industrial companies visit our college for placements, and also salary packages offered are also best. High salary packages are offered here compared to other private colleges as the highest salary package offered is 5 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 2.6 LPA. Just B. Pharmacy students here can get a salary of around Rs. 25,000-30,000 per month. It is a far good salary package compared to other colleges. The maximum of 90% of students get placements, while about 80% of students get good internships. All salary packages offered are good. I am planning to pursue an MBA or M. Pharmacy after this degree. Accenture, Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, HCL, IBM, Infosys, ITC, Pfizer. , Reliance Industries Limited, TCS and also other good companies offer placements and internships here.

hostel.description: Nirma University provides hostel facilities only for post graduate students. All the hostels have basic amenities like water purifiers, common room, recreation room, mess, TV, laundry services, security and surveillance system etc.

library.description:
Nirma University library acts as a key resource and learning center of the University to meet the information needs of more than 6,000 users. It has adopted open source software KOHA for integrated library management. Each constituent institute of the University has a separate library which is located in their respective buildings. To facilitate users with reading and brain storming, separate reading rooms have been provided along with the libraries. Nirma University libraries are fully computerized and collect/ procure a variety of learning resources in different formats like print, online, electronic and digital. It has a collection of 1,07,288 books and 13,661 online periodicals.

Library has subscribed to several Institutional Memberships like INFLIBNET Centre, The American Resource Library center-Mumbai, The British Library – Ahmedabad, Institute of Engineers – Kolkata, Indian Society for Earthquake Technology (ISET), Developing Library Network (DELNET), Indian Geotechnical Society, The Computer Society of India, Vikram Sarabhai Library - IIM.

reviews.review_heading: It has experienced faculty, good infrastructure, and a great campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Labs, classrooms, and the library are equipped with all the necessary requirements. Hostel facilities include a mess, a canteen, medical assistance, and a dedicated sports area. The premises are maintained hygienically with everyday cleaning and sanitation.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: This college provides very well-equipped laboratories and a knowledge resource center. They also provide hostel facilities with proper maintenance and also take care of students with a medical emergencies. Cricket and many other sports are available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is excellent for students.
reviews.review_text: In this college, Wi-Fi, laboratories, classrooms, library, computer laboratories, examination halls, pharmacology laboratories, pharmaceutical laboratories, pharmacognosy laboratories, microbiology laboratories, chemical storage rooms, and rest rooms are provided. It also provides a projector, fans, lights, and instrumentation rooms. The quality is good for mess and canteen.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good facilities and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are well-equipped and well-maintained. Wi-Fi is provided on the whole campus. The library is well-maintained with all the required resources. Hostel premises are clean and hygienic. Food is of decent taste. Sports, medical and canteen and store facilities are available in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good facilities, infrastructure, good campus life, and good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The facilities on campus are very good. Labs are well-equipped and library is maintained with all the useful resources. The campus and hostel are provided with Wi-Fi. Hostel facilities are good and the premises are maintained clean and hygienic. Food is somewhat unsatisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges for pharmacy.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. Every college has its own library, and there is also a big central library where you can get enough books, journals etc. Labs are well-maintained and highly advanced. The hostel is good. Wi-Fi is available in every room. Food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provided good placements from 2008-2021. It has good infrastructure & beautiful scenery.
reviews.review_text: Food quality in the mess is excellent and you can take unlimited. Canteen food is also excellent. They only serve south Indian food and in north Chinese Moghali. The university has two big cricket and football grounds and also a basketball ground and a long tennis ground.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides a good campus life in all aspects.
reviews.review_text: Campus has a good infrastructure with high-speed Wi-Fi and no data limitations. Labs are performed accordingly and classrooms are provided with all facilities that can improve the knowledge of students like projectors. University being a hostage of international students facilities are outstanding.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GITAM Institute of Pharmacy, Visakhapatnam.
reviews.review_text: The course is well designed and they maintain good infrastructure, free Wi-Fi, free access to books, digital library, and other course materials. Students can play various sports tournaments held in cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, etc. Students can also have access to healthcare i.e GIMSR and Dental for less price.

reviews.review_heading: I passed out in the year 2020 during the Covid-19 pandemic.
reviews.review_text: There is a very good library facility here, and sports are not much provided. Wi-Fi is good, and there is a good ambience to study at KRC library. But pharma students can't obtain books from KRC, and they can only get books from the department-specific library on the campus. Canteens are average here. Lab and infrastructure were good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with bad management.
reviews.review_text: There is the best Wi-Fi, good labs and a small library exclusively for us. I don't know about the hostel and medical facilities as I have never utilised them. The playground is really huge, and a lot of sports and competitions are held every now and then. I enrolled in badminton training.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college to learn, but it is not profitable in terms of placements.
reviews.review_text: Labs and equipment are good enough for students, but the only concern is chemicals that are expired or became inactive many years before. It doesn't show the proper chemical process that students have to learn. It is important to maintain good chemicals so that students learn practical processes.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GITAM Institute of Pharmacy, Visakhapatnam.
reviews.review_text: The pharma department has its own block and separate library in GITAM. In the hostel, everything is hygienic, and there is a great environment around the campus. The campus is surrounded by greenery all around. Our campus is located in Rushikonda, a beach arena. Our institute has good laboratories which are always working. There are excellent faculty members who always encourage us to understand and learn every detail.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GITAM Institute of Pharmacy.
reviews.review_text: The institute has modern infrastructure along with proper labs and facilities to research. Many hi-tech instruments like HPLC, Dissolution apparatus, etc., are also available for the students to gain practical experience. The building is seven-storyed with well-equipped labs and classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: The best college to choose.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is so good that you feel like having a luxurious life there. All the classrooms are good enough with the necessary facilities and blackboard. Students can have a peace of mind to study in the classrooms itself. A ground is available to play games.

admission_process.title: Poona College of Pharmacy Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Poona College of Pharmacy is a college of pharmacy that admits numerous UG and postgraduate as well as doctorate degrees in the arena of pharmacy.It has entrance-based admission where the potential candidates shall qualify in the eligibility criteria of their particular course.It is selected by a university-level or a national-level entrance examination then by means of documents examination and paying the fee.
Step 1: Poona College of Pharmacy Application Process

Candidates who want to join Poona College of Pharmacy should apply on the college website or as directed by the college.The application form should be completed with the personal data and academic information, as well as supporting documents.It also needs to be registered in the entrance exams of courses such as BPharm and PharmD.The aspirants need to appear in appropriate exams like ABON with GPAT or PHARMPG or national exams.
Step 2: Entrance Test and Selection

All the admissions to different pharmacy courses in Poona College of Pharmacy are purely based on entrance.The selection for undergraduate degree studies, such as BPharm and PharmD, is carried out based on the ABON computer-based entrance test scores.In MPharm and PharmD (PB), the selection process takes place through GPAT or PHARMPG, whereas admission to PhD follows national-level testing such as UGC-NET, GATE, CSIR-NET or All India Entrance Test.Shortlisting is based on eligibility and performance in these exams.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation

After selection, candidates are notified by the college to proceed with final admission formalities. This includes verification of original documents and payment of the course-specific tuition fee to confirm their seat. Failure to comply within the stipulated time may result in cancellation of the allotted seat. Admission is granted only after fulfilling all academic, entrance, andPoona College of Pharmacy fee.

courses_data.description: Poona College of Pharmacy provides a 4-year BPharm course for students who have passed Class 12 with science. The admission is based on entrance through the BVP CET, and the process is entirely online. Lateral entry, good placement, and internships are also provided by the college.

faqs.question: Is there an entrance exam for BPharm at Poona College of Pharmacy?
faqs.answer: Yes, the BPharm course admission at Poona College of Pharmacy is on the basis of the Bharati Vidyapeeth Common Entrance Test (BVP CET). You have to enroll for the test from the official BVP portal. Final admission is based on merit in the entrance exam.

faqs.question: Is BPharm available at Poona College of Pharmacy?
faqs.answer: Yes, Poona College of Pharmacy provides a full-time BPharm (Bachelor of Pharmacy) course. The course is PCI-approved and is based on pharmaceutical sciences, drug development, and industry training. It is one of the most sought-after courses among students for a career in pharmacy.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admission to BPharm course at Poona College of Pharmacy?
faqs.answer: The minimum eligibility requirement to get admission into the BPharm course at Poona College of Pharmacy is that candidates must complete their Class 12 with Physics and Chemistry as compulsory subjects, and Mathematics/ Biology as one of the subjects, with an aggregate of 45% (40% for the SC/ST category). Moreover, candidates who have completed a DPharm course or any education approved by the Pharmacy Council of India can apply for a BPharm course.Further, candidates are required to appear in BV-PHARMUG (conducted by the affiliating university). Candidates who get shortlisted in the entrance exam will go through a counselling process of spot admission held by the college.

review_summary.college_name: DYPDPU SPR Pimpri Pune Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and facilities for students.

content.Placements: Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences and Research has a strong placement cell, with companies like Cipla, Glenmark, and Dr. Reddy's recruiting students for roles in R&D, quality control, and marketing. The institute also supports internships and higher studies, with solid placement success.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is just awesome, and the classroom is like you are in a 5-star hotel. The college campus provides WiFi and has a well-equipped lab and library. The hostel is quite expensive; the fee is about 2.5 lacs for 10 months. The canteen is also on campus at an affordable price for students.

individual_reviews.course: M.Pharm. in Pharmaceutics - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure and facilities are excellent.

content.Placements: Our college placement cell is really good. Almost every student got placed in good companies like Dr. Reddy, Glenmark, Sun Pharma, GSK, and Cipla. The average package is 4 LP to 6 LP. Hindustan antibiotics, Lupin hire for research internships; we get experience working in the hospital, and it gives us a good stipend of 20,000 rupees.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus life was really good at our festival, Antrang, which is celebrated on a large scale. All syllabus-related reference books are available in the library. Wi-Fi is also available, but we have combined sports grounds for all colleges in DY Patil. Our hostel is very clean; they do cleaning every day, and the food is decent.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Average feedback as old faculty was good but new was not that much.

content.Placements: Placements are there but less opportunity in core pharma. The Opportunities are there, but with lower packages. Many placings are regarding with IT sector, PHARMACOVIGILANCE, and Medical coding. Overall, placements were average. Marketing placements are good.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college was good. The building was spacious and clean. Another building construction has been done as D.pharma added to a course. Cleanliness was too good in the whole building washrooms, common room, restrooms, and office area.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The college is very good with good infrastructure.

content.Placements: Almost 80% of students got good placements with an average package of 3 to 4 Lacs per annum. The highest package offered is around 8 Lacs per annum. Students get placed in companies like GSK, Sun Pharma, Ranbaxy etc. The college provides internships to students.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a good infrastructure with a huge library, and the college provides Wi-Fi facilities for students. The college also has a hostel with good infrastructure and facilities for students. Hostel food is good, but the cost is a bit high. The college hostel fee is 1.8 lakhs.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall, I am happy with placements and exams.

content.Placements: Placements are good. They offer various salary packages ranging from 2 LPA to 5 LPA. Various companies like Dr. Reddy's visit the college for recruitment.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is kind of old but good. The design is great. Various facilities, like a boys' common room, a gymkhana, and spacious labs, are available. The hostel is like a five-star hotel. It's very good but also costly, so all students can't afford it. Overall, the food quality is fine.
content.Faculty: Faculty members are of mixed behavior. Some are polite and good with excellent teaching methods, and some are very rude and frustrated toward students. Exams are conducted each week. We have continuous assessments and sessional exams twice a semester.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good coaching and clean college.

content.Placements: Around 80%-90% of students from our course were placed through campus recruitment drives. Highest package is 20 LPA. Lowest package is 5 LPA. Around 70%-75% of students secure an internship through campus drives. Top roles offered are software development engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel has clean and well-maintained rooms, a common study hall, and a 24/7 water and electricity supply. Mess provides balanced diet food with vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. Facilities for both indoor and outdoor sports. Medical, 24/7 ambulance service.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Excellent infrastructure with supportive faculty and good placements.

content.Placements: I am part of the 2024 to 2028 batch. My seniors who passed away from this college received many packages mentioned below. Placement Percentage around 80 to 90% of students are placed from our course. The highest package is 20 LPA, the lowest package is 6 LPA, and the average package is 8 LPA. Some of the top recruiters included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, HCL, and a few product based companies. Internship Opportunities Nearly 70 to 80% of students got internships, often in companies like TCS, Infosys, Startups, and local IT firms, which provided good exposure. The major roles offered are Software Developer, Analyst, Associate Engineer, System Engineer, Data Analyst, and Support Engineer.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Information about Sri Ramachandra life.

content.Placements: Our college offers 100% placements to eligible students. The average package offered is between 4 LPA and 10 LPA. The college has a dedicated placement team. The college organizes on-campus events to help students find jobs and internships. The college has a strong placement network.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has one of the largest medical libraries in the region, and collaborates with Harvard Medical International. It has a large collection of textbooks, journals, and more. We also have modern laboratories. It also exercises physiology labs with metabolic analyzers, treadmills, and more. There is a sports biomechanics lab with 3D cameras, forceplates, and more. We have a podiatry lab with foot pressure analysis systems. There is an anthropometry lab with stadiometers and more.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Medical Microbiology and Applied Molecular Biology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Sriher a glimpse. Absolutely good infrastructure and social life. The faculty is very friendly.

content.Placements: Our course doesn't have placement arrangements. So I have no idea about it. I don't know what I should say about this topic. But our college does provide a 6-month internship programme within the campus to have hands-on experience with everything we have learnt in these years.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available are top-notch. There are no compensations for infrastructure. All classrooms are equipped with Wi-Fi connections, smart boards, projectors, etc. The library has a vast number of books about various fields of study and journals. The canteen facilities and medical facilities are good because they have their hospital set up as this is a medical college.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and faculty members.

content.Placements: There are 250 students in one batch. For MBBS internships are only required in the final year after completion of the course. According to central lawns internships are in the same hospital as the study. After MBBS and internship, there are multiple opportunities to go abroad for further training, as well as opportunities to remain in India and pursue an MS or an MD. As for research, the faculty members are incredibly helpful and the university offers grants for students who wish to engage in research. The medical college is also recognised by the USA for further studies there.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: It is a smart and advanced college in the name of an engineering college.

review_content.Placements: The placement ratio is 90%, which means most students get placed. But the problem is that most students get placed in either TCS or Infosys. They are service-based companies and offer almost 3–4 LPA, while very few students, like 1 in 200, get placed in product-based companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very poor. They have Wi-Fi with no internet connection. Classrooms are exactly like school classrooms, and there is no AC or cooler in the classrooms. The canteen is too small, the library is okay, but there are no good sports facilities. I can say that sports are below average.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: NIET has good placement. Faculty are very supportive, and the infrastructure is average.

review_content.Placements: NIET offers average placement opportunities, especially for core and emerging branches. Top recruiters are TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. The average package is around 6 LPA, and the highest package is around 52 LPA. Around 60 to 70 percent of students are placed. And some students get internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: Previously, the NIET infrastructure was very bad, but they have improved their infrastructure. The campus size is very small, but NIET has a total of 3 individual infrastructure plots 14, 15, and 19. Plot 15 are the newly made campus for first-year students. The campus life at NIET is very good. I extremely recommend first-year students to take the college hostel. The food quality is decent, Wi-Fi is good, and medical sports facilities are also very good. The infrastructure of classes is that every class has a smart board, but the tables are very bad. Canteens are very good.

review_summary.college_name: NIET Gr Noida Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A decent college with decent placements.

content.Placements: If you have a 7+ CGPA with no ongoing backlogs, there is almost a 90% certainly of in-campus placement. As the college has tie-ups with mass recruiters, you are likely to get a placement, but don't expect the placement numbers to be very good or satisfactory. Some recruiters include Infosys, TCS, HCL, etc. , with an average package of around 6 LPA and the highest touching up to 54 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure here at NIET is honestly a bit of a mixed bag. For our CSE labs, the equipment is actually quite decent and up-to-date, and the smart boards in the classrooms make lectures easier to follow. The central library is huge and has almost every book you’d need, though it gets super crowded during exams. However, the Wi-Fi can be a real pain. It's okay in the labs, but in the hostel, the speed is pretty consistent, and they have a lot of blocked sites, which is frustrating when you're trying to work on projects.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Bad infrastructure and college life.

content.Placements: In my course, which is B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, there are about 240 students last year out of which about 120 to 140 are placed last year. The highest and the lowest packages are 39 LPA and 3 LPA respectively. The top recruiting companies are Accenture, Wipro, Razor, TCS etc. About the internship, there are only 4 to 5 students who got a properly paid internship from the college others are enrolled in internships. They are required to pay to get enrolled and some got to companies by outreaching to them. The top roles offered are software developers, frontend developers, backend developers etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is a smart and advanced college in the name of an engineering college.

content.Placements: The placement ratio is 90%, which means most students get placed. But the problem is that most students get placed in either TCS or Infosys. They are service-based companies and offer almost 3–4 LPA, while very few students, like 1 in 200, get placed in product-based companies.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very poor. They have Wi-Fi with no internet connection. Classrooms are exactly like school classrooms, and there is no AC or cooler in the classrooms. The canteen is too small, the library is okay, but there are no good sports facilities. I can say that sports are below average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: NIET has good placement. Faculty are very supportive, and the infrastructure is average.

content.Placements: NIET offers average placement opportunities, especially for core and emerging branches. Top recruiters are TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. The average package is around 6 LPA, and the highest package is around 52 LPA. Around 60 to 70 percent of students are placed. And some students get internships.
content.Infrastructure: Previously, the NIET infrastructure was very bad, but they have improved their infrastructure. The campus size is very small, but NIET has a total of 3 individual infrastructure plots 14, 15, and 19. Plot 15 are the newly made campus for first-year students. The campus life at NIET is very good. I extremely recommend first-year students to take the college hostel. The food quality is decent, Wi-Fi is good, and medical sports facilities are also very good. The infrastructure of classes is that every class has a smart board, but the tables are very bad. Canteens are very good.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Neutral placement and infrastructure is okay-okay.

content.Placements: Around 20-30% of students are placed in MCA. The highest package is 6 LPA, the lowest package is 3 LPA, and average is 3 LPA - 4 LPA. For recruiting, both technical and non-technical companies visit to hire students. Recruiting companies are TCS, Accenture, Infosys, and Capgemini. Top roles offered are software developer and technical support.
content.Infrastructure: College has two small campuses for computer application students, and classes are conducted in both campuses. Sometimes classes are held in one campus and sometimes in another, which became frustrating for the students. Wi-Fi, library, and classrooms are available. But there is no sitting area and lunch area for students. Computer labs are available and used for practical sessions.

individual_reviews.title: This college is a very good option for those whose budget is low and who belong to Bihar.

content.Placements: 80 to 90 percent of students were placed this year. The placement range of each department is very good, and almost all of them are placed. The pharmacy departments placement range is better than other departments, and the placement range of HMCT is also good.
content.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure is available for each departments students, and facilities such as Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms and a library are also available. Single bedrooms, double bedrooms and 5 seater bedrooms are also available. Good quality food is available in both the mess and the canteen.

individual_reviews.course: BCA Google Cloud Program (GCP) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely good because of the faculty, good environment, and infrastructure.

content.Placements: I am a student of Suresh Gyan Vihar University pursuing BCA with Google Cloud. Many companies offer to those students who have the highest score ranking. SGVU is a private university located in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. It was established in 2008, under the Suresh Gyan Vihar University, Jaipur, ACT 2008, ACT No. 16 of 2008. individual_reviews.course: M.Pharma in Pharmaceutics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: One thing I love about is the peaceful environment over here.

content.Placements: I great place where you can be hire by the top recruiters. Many seniors are there who have been selected because of their dedication towards the field. Package depends on the interview sessions on an average it is 4lpa. Internship opportunities come from government labs.
content.Infrastructure: We have excellent library, full network Wi-Fi, interactive classrooms, well-equipped labs. In hostel it will like home. Well cooked food, safe drinking water, access to gym, ground for various sports. There is also activity area helps to focus on your hobbies.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Marketing - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Well-maintained campus with decent placements needs better faculty.

content.Placements: I completed my MBA from the 2022-2024 batch. Around 85% of students from our course were successfully placed. The highest package offered was 12 LPA, the lowest was 3.5 LPA and the average package stood at 6.8 LPA. Top recruiting companies included TCS, Infosys, Deloitte, Wipro, and Accenture. Nearly 70% of students secured internships in firms like EY, HDFC Bank, ICICI, and Capgemini. The most offered roles were business analyst, marketing executive, financial analyst, operations associate, and hr executive.
content.Infrastructure: Our department was well-equipped with modern classrooms, Wi-Fi, computer labs, and a dedicated library section for academic support. Hostel facilities were decent with clean rooms, 24/7 water and electricity, and good security. The mess served hygienic food with a fair variety, while the canteen offered snacks and beverages. Basic medical support was available on campus. Sports facilities included grounds for cricket, volleyball, and indoor games.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Commerce (M.Com) in Accountancy - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college in Jaipur.

content.Placements: I remember when I was pursuing an M.Com from this university, almost 60% of students got placements with the highest package of 6 LPA. Many students got internship opportunities from multinational companies. I pursued M.Com online from this university.
content.Infrastructure: I visited the university campus once. The infrastructure of the university is large, good, and vibrant. The SGVU library contains a number of books, and I hear it is the largest library among universities. The whole campus is covered with greenery. The SGVU campus is too good for pursuing our degree.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good because of the faculty, good environment, and infrastructure.

Basic medical support was available on campus. Sports facilities included grounds for cricket, volleyball, and indoor games.

There is a good environment for hostel students to live in and various stadium for sports based on the different volleyball, basketball, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely a world of growing opportunities.

review_summary.college_name: Integral University Lucknow Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am dissatisfied with the faculty and also with the university system.

content.Placements: If we talk about placements, then we can't get anything from college. We can't even get anything with the help of faculty members. We have to do everything on our own. We have to make many efforts to secure a placement or take a job because the placement rate is only on paper, and there's nothing like getting a good placement and a good job with 30 or 40 LPA in BCA at Integral University. After admission, they say only one thing, that it's our own responsibility to get a job, and they can't do anything if we are an average student.
content.Infrastructure: We do not get any facilities for 1.5 lakhs, as it's the charge for 1 year of stay in the hostel. The hostel does not have AC. We don't get a single almirah or single B.Ed or anything else. It does not have a Wi-Fi system. There is no mess system included in it, and we have to give extra charges for the mess system. We don't have access to go out or in anytime we want. The room area is full of dust, or we can say the paint on the walls is very old. It has scratches. There is no single cleaner in the hostel building.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The college gave good placements.

content.Placements: The placement of our university is very good. There are many companies that recruit students from our university at the best package prices. The top companies' names are Flipkart, HCL, Teach, Amazon, Mahindra, and many other companies like Paytm and Google Pay.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities of labs and classrooms are good, and the Wi-Fi network is also very good. The library is not very good, the facilities of the hostel are quite bad, and the food in the hostel is also poor. The ground is very good at our university, and many sports are played there.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Amazing, and most of the students are satisfied with the infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: In the last 4–5 years, in my course, the percentage of students who got placed is 67 percent. The highest package is 12 LPA, the average is 7 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The companies are Tata, Google, Flipkart, Sierra, and Techno. At least 12–15 students got placed in Flipkart, and some in Tata.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel infrastructure is great, with privacy and security at their best. The food in the hostel is hygienic and tasty. They have a very dynamic schedule for dinner, lunch, and breakfast, and they also provide snacks every evening around 5 pm. The rooms are well cleaned and have good bed quality. They also provide medical facilities and a sports complex.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Biotechnology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the university is excellent. Faculty members are good, but the placement rate is low.

content.Placements: The average package is about 2.5–3 LPA. Companies visit, but not very frequently. Overall, the placement rate is good compared to other universities in Lucknow. However, if you only want placement, you should consider a university other than Integral University.
content.Infrastructure: My course is B.Sc. Biotechnology, and its fee is Rs. 90,000 per year. Hostel fees are separate and vary according to the type of room you choose. Mainly, two kinds of rooms are available here. They are AC and non-AC. The rooms are triple-sharing. Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors, microphones, and speakers.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: If you are serious about your studies, then you can study here otherwise, you cannot.

content.Placements: In my knowledge, only 10 to 15% get the placement. The highest placement of 2024 is 34 LPA. Top recruiting company in this college is TCS. Many students get paid internships, only 10 to 15% and the remaining 50% are unpaid. Top roles offered in our course are Software Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in the labs, and AC is also available. Every classroom department has its library, and there is a Central library where you can study. The quality of the hostel is very good. Food is average, and the mess is there. All medical facilities, sports, and games are also available.

Applications of the candidates whosequalifying exams(such as IUET) arerecognised by the universitywill only be considered at the time of admission. IUET, a computer-based exam, will be held at the University campus. Candidates have to qualify for all the rounds of the selection process. Find below the detailed process around Integral University admissions 2025:
1. Integral University Application

Candidates applying for admission to courses offered at Integral University are required tofill application form either in online or offline mode. Candidates have to fill the form with basic details such as personal and educational information. Along with that, they also have to submit the relevant documents and pay an application fee before submitting the form.
2. Selection Rounds

For the selection of eligible applicants, the university accepts scores of various state national-level entrance exams. Candidates can also appear for theIUET exam, which is conducted by the university itself. The aspirants must qualify for any one of the entrance exams to qualify the Integral University selection process.
3. Final Admission

After the completion of all selection rounds, candidates will be evaluated based on their past academic scores and scores of the respective entrance exams. Later on, the university will release the merit list of the selected candidates. Candidates whose names appeared on the merit list must pay acertain amount of feeto confirm their seats.

hostel.description: Integral University has 3 hostels for boys and 2 hostels for girls. The facilities provided in the hostels are common room equipped with indoor game facilities, playground and courts for outdoor games like badminton, volleyball, cricket, skating, lawn tennis, basketball, etc., gymnasium, 24 Hrs. wi-fi, water purifier, parking, guest rooms, reading room.
facilities: The campus is only 30 km from Lucknow airport and railway station
The seminar hall is well-equipped with audio-visual facilities and can accommodate 400 students
Two special lecture theatres are available for closer interaction between the recruiters and the students. Each lecture theatre is built like an amphitheatre and has a seating of 80 students
Air-conditioned group discussion rooms/ interview rooms/ conference rooms

library.description: Integral University has central as well as departmental library. The central library has the collection of more than 0.1 million documents comprising of books, theses, journals, dissertations and CDs/DVDs in the fields of applied sciences, bio sciences, engineering, medical sciences, education, humanities, literature and management with a seating capacity of 600 readers. The library collection includes 99255 volumes. The library also has the subscription of 300 printed and 7010 online journals with 2731 eBooks, 47000 articles, 3700 full text articles and 5875 indexed articles through online databases like Oxford university press, Cambridge university press. The library is fully automated by automated software KOHA.

reviews.review_heading: The college gave good placements.
reviews.review_text: The facilities of labs and classrooms are good, and the Wi-Fi network is also very good. The library is not very good, the facilities of the hostel are quite bad, and the food in the hostel is also poor. The ground is very good at our university, and many sports are played there.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing, and most of the students are satisfied with the infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure is great, with privacy and security at their best. The food in the hostel is hygienic and tasty. They have a very dynamic schedule for dinner, lunch, and breakfast, and they also provide snacks every evening around 5 pm. The rooms are well cleaned and have good bed quality. They also provide medical facilities and a sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the university is excellent. Faculty members are good, but the placement rate is low.
reviews.review_text: My course is B.Sc. Biotechnology, and its fee is Rs. 90,000 per year. Hostel fees are separate and vary according to the type of room you choose. Mainly, two kinds of rooms are available here. They are AC and non-AC. The rooms are triple-sharing. Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors, microphones, and speakers.

reviews.review_heading: If you are serious about your studies, then you can study here otherwise, you cannot.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in the labs, and AC is also available. Every classroom department has its library, and there is a Central library where you can study. The quality of the hostel is very good. Food is average, and the mess is there. All medical facilities, sports, and games are also available.

reviews.review_heading: The teachers are very helpful and help with students' careers.

The quality of facilities is good in the hostel, the mess, and the canteen. Medical facilities have improved, and games are conducted regularly.

reviews.review_heading: Now the teachers are very good, and they help in students' career building.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure were good. We had strong Wi-Fi connection and different kinds of labs, digital classroom, and library. The quality of facilities in hostel was hygienic, and provided 3 times meals. All meds were available in the medical room. There was a small playground in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: A good university with a good atmosphere, nothing is over the board as I have seen at other colleges

reviews.review_heading: A good and lovely college.

reviews.review_heading: It's fantastic, and its infrastructure is very good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is excellent. It has a very big campus with a cafeteria and garden area. You can just sit in the garden and spend time with your friends. There is a library with extremely good and helpful books which we can take from there. They also have AC in the classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very nice. Teaching staff is very good and helpful and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities like museum, labs, classes, smart classes, and library are well maintained and managed on 7 floors. Library has every book needed.  We get free Wi-Fi on campus. It provides best infrastructure. Some classes are AC classes, good canteen, and fresh food served.

reviews.review_heading: Integral University: A university that gives wings to your dreams.
reviews.review_text: The university has AC classrooms with A1 infrastructure, Wi-Fi available for students, smart boards and projectors in every classroom, and a library with fully furnished ACs, teachers are very supportive and provide different types of study materials like PDFs and notes; the hostel infrastructure is top class with AC in every room, elevators along with stairs featuring the latest technology in both hostel and university buildings, healthy and tasty food with proper hygiene is prepared at the can...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Although facilities are good. Infrastructure is good. Canteen and eating outlets are there. We have good transportation system and budget friendly. Good food is available at university with pocket-friendly prices. Departments are good and clean with good environment.
